GBUK Group|caretip™ secure.description: Continence Care CareTip™ Secure The CareTip Secure fixation device is designed to provide secure fixation of uretheral catheters. Appropriate securement may reduce adverse outcomes, including catheter dislodgement, tissue trauma and necrosis, inflammation and urinary tract infections (UTIs). Features a medical silicone gel adhesive, renowned for exceptional skin compatibility Designed for pain free and residue free removal – Minimising discomfort and trauma to fragile skin Durable 360 degree swivel clip to allow comfortable patient movement without tugging, reducing the risk of urethral trauma or catheter dislodgement Easy to apply, with secure latch, effectively resists accidental pull forces Translucent material,to allow skin inspection beneath Suitable for continuous use for up to 7 days Shower-proof
features: Features a medical silicone gel adhesive, renowned for exceptional skin compatibility
Designed for pain free and residue free removal – Minimising discomfort and trauma to fragile skin
Durable 360 degree swivel clip to allow comfortable patient movement without tugging, reducing the risk of urethral trauma or catheter dislodgement
Easy to apply, with secure latch, effectively resists accidental pull forces
Translucent material,to allow skin inspection beneath

Vygon (UK)|expert umbilical catheter.description: The expert umbilical catheter is the only umbilical catheter with integrated antimicrobial Agion® technology, to fight against CRBSI in NICUs. Ag+ is bacteriostatic that inhibits the cell reproduction. Ag+ combine with bacterial proteins located in the cell wall and cytoplasm which interferes with their normal functioning. These proteins are vital for the healthy functioning of the cell therefore loss of the proteins results in the death of the bacteria. Clinical performances “A reduction in catheter-related bloodstream infections in preterm infants found from using catheters with the Agion® antimicrobial system.”(11) “Preterms with an expert umbilical venous catheter had shorter hospital stays and a lower case fatality rate.”(11) “There was no case of intolerance to the Agion® catheters and none of these catheters had to be removed due to a local skin infection. In addition, none of the patients in the Agion® catheter group showed signs of silver toxicity.”(11)

Mölnlycke|trays.description: Surgical solutions Trays Our surgical trays Our customised procedure trays contain all the products and solutions needed for a surgical procedure. Highlighting the ability to include everything you need for a specific intervention in a single procedure tray, the procedure tray category shows the value and efficiency of customisation. Time saving with ProcedurePak® tray vs single-packed Mölnlycke customised procedure trays are assembled to contain all the single-use components required for a particular surgical intervention. Replacing a large number of individually packaged items, ProcedurePak trays can generate significant savings in time and costs for both major and minor surgery procedures. Preparation time for surgical procedures can be cut by more than half compared to traditional preparation of the operation room. Increasing OR efficiency Hospitals and healthcare managers around the world are finding better ways to improve internal processes to save time and increase efficiency in the operating room. Their goals include improving outcomes while ensuring quality and safety. That involves making best use of the resources they have, easing the stress on healthcare professionals s

Felgains|rehasense eco travel wheelchair.description: Introducing the Rehasense Eco Travel power add-on for manual wheelchairs – a game-changer for those seeking enhanced mobility on the go. Designed with your mobility in mind, the Eco Travel is the lightest power add-on in the Rehasense lineup, compact and easy to take with you wherever you go. Whether you are at home, on the road, or exploring new places, it has been built for convenience and independence. The Eco Travel effortlessly transforms your manual wheelchair into a powerful, easy-to-manoeuvre companion, perfect for both short trips and extended journeys. You can choose between the two versions Eco Travel Standard (BX) or Eco Travel Advanced (LX). Thanks to the modular system, assembly is quick and easy, with no pre-assembled brackets required. With a range of up to 45 km, it has the greatest range of any product in its class. It is compatible with rigid and folding models, as well as models with removable leg rests (frame width 220–480 mm). A dual braking system and self-centring mechanism ensure control, stability and safety.

Felgains|compressionaid.description: The CompressionAid is a unique aid for putting on compression stockings and for foot care in bed, which, thanks to its ergonomic design, ensures a smoother, less stressful workflow for the back, shoulders, arms, and fingers. The unique design makes it possible to attach compression stockings without lifting legs, reducing the physical strain typically put on caregivers when applying stockings. CompressionAid is made from strong, durable materials: The plate is made of compact laminate The black comfort rollers are made of PUR The black tubes that hold the comfort rollers are made of POM

Felgains|sterling s50 carbon mobility sc.description: Tired of heavy, bulky folding mobility scooters built for a weight target, not the real world? Meet the boldly elegant S50 Carbon. Inspire Community Trust|uccello kettle.description: The Uccello Kettle is a safe and elegant assistive technology that makes handling boiling water safely seem effortless. It opens up a world of confidence and independence for anyone who wishes to handle boiling water safely. Unlike other kettles and kettle-tippers, the circular shape of the Uccello Kettle, combined with its rotating cradle, moves around the body of water to assist the flow of the pour, so you don t have to lift, strain, balance or aim. The positioning and shape of the ergonomically designed Uccello handle means weight is distributed across the entire arm, not on fingers and wrists, which makes it easier to handle comfortably. While most kettles require that you awkwardly lift and hold open the spout while refilling, the Uccello s one touch to open hinged lid, requires the lightest of touches to tap open or close. Uccello s detachable water body vessel sits comfortably within a sturdy base that has the added safety of non slip feet for further stability of pour. The black and white contrast design of the Kettle, helps individuals with dementia and low visibility differentiate the important parts of the Kettle, including the easy touch lid button. This elegant feature is also a safety feature. From first to last drop of boiling water, the tapered design of the spout ensures water is targeted to the same spot every time, without the splashing, inconsistency or lack of control experienced with ordinary kettle pours. With so much peace of mind including a wide opening for easy filling, quiet boiling and auto shut off protection from overheating Uccello brings you the next level in safe, elegant and effortless assistive technology. 1.5 litre (6 cup) capacity.

Guldmann|gh3 lifting module.description: The GH3 ceiling hoist is a stationary lifting module that is user-friendly and powerful enough to handle lifting and moving procedures in almost all professional care settings.

Guldmann|gh3plus lifting module.description: The GH3+ ceiling lift is a faster, sturdier and more powerful version of the standard GH3 lifting module. It is designed for use in almost all professional care settings, and with a lifting capacity of up to 400 kg on a single strap, it is ideal for use in bariatric care.

Guldmann|trainer module for gh3plus.description: A GH3+ hoist equipped with the Trainer Module provides you with the possibility to improve patient mobility and physical function with dynamic body weight support. This supports early mobilization and training opportunities.

Guldmann|class iii scale module for gh3p.product: Class Iii Scale Module For Gh3Plus
Guldmann|class iii scale module for gh3p.description: The Class III Scale is an approved medical scale integrated into a ceiling hoist, fulfilling the conditions for medical weighing with calibrated, verified and repeated weight measurements with Class III precision.

Guldmann|gh3 twin module.description: The GH3 Twin ceiling hoist comprises two GH3 lifting modules and uses two lifting straps. This module is designed for lifting and moving heavy bariatric people, and is also ideal for horizontal lifts in combination with Guldmann Horizontal Lifters.

Guldmann|gh1 lifting module.description: The GH1 lifting module has been designed to deal with day-to-day lifting needs typically encountered in private homes, sheltered accommodation and nursing homes. It takes up little space, is easy to operate and helps make lifting and moving processes safe, simple and comfortable for user and care staff alike.

Guldmann|gh1plus lifting module.description: The GH1+ ceiling hoist combines the proven reliability of the GH1 with built in online functionality.

Guldmann|gh1 q lifting module.description: The GH1 Q lifting module is a variation of the GH1 model, supplied with a click system that makes it simple to fit the lifting module to the rails and remove it again if it is necessary to move the module to a different room or apartment.

Guldmann|gh1plus q lifting module.description: The GH1+ Q ceiling hoist combines the proven performance of the GH1 Q with built in online functionality.

Guldmann|gh1 f lifting module.description: The GH1 F is a versatile lifting module that is simple to move from one room to another using the associated transport and storage trolley. The module automatically fits itself to and removes itself from the rail system, which means that carers avoid lifting, stretching and bearing heavy loads when moving and fitting the ceiling hoist.

Guldmann|ghz lifting module.description: The GHZ is a discreet – almost invisible – patient lift that ensures safe and comfortable lifts and an ergonomically safe working environment for care staff.

Guldmann|abc rails.description: There are three types of rails – A, B and C. The three different versions have been optimised in relation to bearing capacity and reach, and they can all be installed quickly and easily. The rails can be installed on walls, ceilings and floor-mounted brackets – or using any combination of these. .

Guldmann|wall rails.description: Guldmann wall rails are designed for direct installation on all types of wall. A flexible traverse rail can be used with the wall rail system to compensate automatically for irregularities of up to 80 mm.

Guldmann|combi lock.description: The Guldmann Combi-lock is used to link two rail systems. Using the combi-lock, you can link two rail systems – between bedroom and bathroom, for example – to ensure an easy, comfortable move for the patient.

Guldmann|switch track.description: Switch track modules are designed for installation in places where it is necessary or desirable to run rails in different directions

Guldmann|turntable.description: A turntable is designed for situations in which it is necessary to run the rail system in several directions. In practice, this electrically operated turntable is installed where two rails intersect, allowing the ceiling hoist to move in multiple directions.

Guldmann|positioning lock.description: The Positioning lock adds yet another option to the Guldmann GH3 ceiling hoist system for moving, treating, mobilising and rehabilitating people.

Guldmann|upright support bracket.description: The Upright support bracket is ideal for installations where rails cannot be fixed to the wall or ceiling – in rooms with large windows, for example.

Guldmann|free standing rail system room.product: Free Standing Rail System Room Covering Length And Height Adjustable
Guldmann|free standing rail system room.description: The free-standing rail system is a mobile system that covers the entire room. It is simple to put up, take down and transfer from one location to another.

Guldmann|free standing rail system room.product: Free Standing Rail System Room Covering
Guldmann|free standing rail system room.description: The free-standing rail system is a mobile system that covers the entire room. It is simple to put up, take down and transfer from one location to another.

Guldmann|gtp1 transfer platform.description: The Transfer platform is a manual, mobile working tool that makes it easier to move standing and semi-independent users. Guldmann|gl52 mobile lifter.description: Mobile Lifters constitute a floor-based alternative to ceiling-mounted lifting and moving systems. Two versions of the GL5.2 model are available with lifting capacities of 155 and 205 kg, respectively.

Kimal PLC|flowxl® transit-time flowmeter.description: Surgical complications — like premature graft failure due to unseen flow restrictions— can negatively affect patient outcomes and the hospital’s reputation. Any surgical procedure whose basis is to augment, restrict, or create new flow pathways should involve quantitative flow measurements to verify intraoperative flow rates and to inform the surgeon’s clinical impressions. Intraoperative volume flow measurements with the FlowXL, Transonic’s newest transit-time ultrasound flow measurement system, give the surgeon peace of mind prior to closing and helps the surgeon ensure the best possible outcome for their patient. The Transonic FlowXL ® is a standalone, touchscreen Flowmeter used during surgery with Transonic’s Flowprobes to measure, display, and document absolute volume flow and other derived flow parameters in blood vessels and ducts. It is now even easier to use in a new versatile, configurable system designed to suit all user needs. QuickFlow or AdvancedFlow options allow the user to choose the software functionality that fits their workflows. Related Products Coronary Flowprobes (FMC Series) COnfidence Flowprobes (AU-Series) Transonic Extracranial Charbel Micro-Flowprobes (MR-S & MB-S Series) Transonic Intracranial Charbel Micro-Flowprobes (MR & MB-Series) Transonic Microvascular Flowprobes (MU-Series) Transonic Vascular Flowprobes (FMV-Series) Transonic Carotid Flowprobes

Kimal PLC|transonic carotid flowprobes.description: For Use During Carotid Endarterectomy Designed specifically for use during carotid endarterectomy, Carotid Flowprobes feature a handle with a short, flexible neck and L-style reflector. This style allows the Flowprobes to slip on and off the vessel under study without temporarily squeezing the vessel. This reduces the chance of dislodging plaque from the intima of the vessel wall. Carotid Flowprobes could be used in other applications where vessel constriction is of great concern. Product Overview: – Sizes 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm for small to mid-sized vessels. – L-style reflector for easy, non-constrictive application. – Short, flexible neck. – Gold standard transit-time ultrasound illumination. – Excellent measurement resolution and accuracy.

Kimal PLC|transonic vascular flowprobes.description: Vascular Flowprobes for General Vascular, Transplant, and Cardiac Surgery Vascular surgeons tailor their procedures to the specific needs of their patients. Intraoperative volume blood flow measurements with Transonic Vascular Flowprobes (FMV-Series) provide a vascular surgeon with on-the-spot, quantitative feedback about their surgery. The measurements may confirm what appears to be an acceptable surgical result, or alert the surgeon to potential problems at a time when they can be readily addressed. Volume flow measurements with FMV Vascular Flowprobes are used to: – Check the quality of inflow at the onset of a bypass. – Quantify the carrying capacity of a bypass, and check for kinks or twists in a graft. – Quantify augmentation of outflow, and confirm the patency of the operative repair. FMV-Series Vascular Flowprobes feature a short flexible neck for applications where the artery, vein, or graft is readily accessible. The J-style reflector is designed to quickly slip around the vessel and maintain optimal vessel alignment while performing a flow measurement. Their universal design makes them applicable for use in general vascular, transplant, and/or cardiac surgeries.

Kimal PLC|transonic microvascular flowpr.description: The Smallest Clinical Flowprobes on the Market The patency of microvascular vessels following an anastomoses poses a challenge for microvascular surgeons. Transonic’s Microvascular Perivascular Flowprobes, for volume flow measurements in blood vessels, grafts, or ducts, offer the surgeon an elegant tool to determine anastomotic patency. With unsurpassed accuracy, MU-Series Microvascular Flowprobes provide immediate, quantitative data to objectively assess the quality of an anastomosis, reconstruction, or replantation. As surgeons evaluate surgical progress, quantitative measurements with MU-Series Microvascular Flowprobes either support their clinical impressions or signal a problem with the anastomosis. Microvascular Flowprobes are designed with a non-constrictive fit, an L-style reflector, and a short flexible neck for easy application which will not alter flow during a measurement, or damage tiny vessels during application. Product Overview: – Sizes: 0.7, 1, 1.5, 2, and 3 mm. – Measures in vessels 0.5 to 4.0 mm in diameter. – Compatible with Optima and FlowXL Meters.

Kimal PLC|transonic intracranial charbel.description: Measure volume flow in intracranial vessels during cerebrovascular surgeries Intracranial Charbel Micro-Flow Probes ® are designed for intracranial surgery including aneurysm clipping, arteriovenous malformations (AVMs), dural fistula obliteration, and tumor resection surgeries. They feature a long bayonet handle for use under a surgical microscope and a flexible neck segment which permits bending the flowprobe as needed for positioning around a vessel. The Intracranial Charbel Micro-Flow Probe® is complemented by the extracranial version which features a shorter bayonet handle and larger sizes for EC-IC procedures. – MB-Series are single-use, pre-sterilized probes, for use when transmission of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease is a concern. – MR-Series are multi-use, sterilizable flowprobes. Product Overview: – Sizes 1.5, 2, and 3mm for cerebral vasculature. – L-style reflector for easy, non-constrictive application. – Long bayonet handle and flexible neck. – Transit-time ultrasound technology. – Excellent measurement resolution and accuracy.

Kimal PLC|transonic extracranial charbel.product: Transonic Extracranial Charbel Micro-Flowprobes (MR-S & MB-S Series)
Kimal PLC|transonic extracranial charbel.description: Measure volume flow in extracranial vessels during cerebrovascular surgeries Short bayonet-handle Extracranial Flowprobes are designed to be used under the microscope during EC-IC bypass surgery. Flow measurement can be used to quantify an increase in flow after revascularization surgery for occlusive disease or to determine the carrying capacity of a bypass. The Extracranial Charbel Micro-Flowprobe ® is complemented by its Intracranial counterpart which features a longer bayonet handle and smaller sizes for deep cerebrovascular procedures. – MB-S-Series are single-use, pre-sterilized flowprobes for use when transmission of Creutzfeldt-Jacob disease is a concern. – MR-S-Series are multi-use, sterilizable flowprobes. Product Overview: – Sizes 3, 4, and 6 mm. – L-style reflector for easy, non-constrictive application. – Short bayonet handle and flexible neck. – Gold standard transit-time ultrasound illumination. – Excellent measurement resolution and accuracy.

Kimal PLC|transonic confidence flowprobe.description: Flowprobes with Unsurpassed Accuracy in Turbulent Vessels Transonic’s COnfidence cardiac output flowprobes represent a unique concept in ultrasonic flowprobe design. Validated X-pattern full flow illumination is enhanced by a soft probe liner to cushion the vessel, permitting sustained ultrasonic transmission during acute intraoperative use. COnfidence Flowprobes ® offer unsurpassed beat-to-beat measurement accuracy on vessels with highly dynamic and irregular flow profiles, such as the great arteries, during adult or pediatric cardiothoracic surgery. – Insensitive to flow profile: Provides accurate and reproducible measurements on the ascending, arch or descending aorta. – Designed for placement in tight spaces: Surgical space is not compromised. – Shaped to fit: The inner surface is designed for round vessels, and the probes come with soft liner, so that they may be left in place for extended periods of time without risk of damaging the vessel. Product Overview: – Sizes 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20*, 24*, 28*, 32*, and 36* mm specifically sized for wide range of vessels. – Reusable transducer shell with easy-to-use, single-use Ultrafit Liners. – Vessel protection and cushioning for the duration of the procedure. – Gold standard measurement using X-pattern transit-time ultrasound illumination, providing more accurate readings on turbulent flows. – Immediate, accurate, beat-to-beat flow measurements. – High-resolution uninterrupted signal during intraoperative procedures. – Custom calibration available for synthetic grafts and implanted VADs. *These flowprobes come with two Ultrafit Liner sizes for improved fit. Additional available Ultrafit Liner sizes are 18, 22, 26, 30, and 34 mm.

Kimal PLC|transonic coronary flowprobes.description: Coronary Flowprobes Customized for CABG Coronary Flowprobes are specifically designed for CABG patency assessment. These Flowprobes feature an extended handle that allows the surgeon to measure flow in hard-to-reach coronary bypass grafts behind the heart, a flexible neck to optimally position the Flowprobes around a graft, and a J-shaped reflector to hold a graft within the non-constrictive sensing window to provide an undistorted flow waveform, critical for graft patency assessment.

Kimal PLC|radial compression band.description: A radial compression band is intended for use following trans radial artery access procedures to support controlled haemostasis at the wrist puncture site. The device is designed to apply adjustable, localized pressure to assist in achieving haemostasis while supporting arterial patency. The radial compression band is used as part of standard post-procedural care to help manage bleeding at the access site and to support the reduction of procedure-related complications. Kit Contents Complete with: Compression band 20ml Syringe Features and Benefits Support for Patent Haemostasis : The device is designed to allow the application of controlled pressure intended to support haemostasis while maintaining arterial blood flow, in line with established clinical practice. Support for Complication Management: By providing localised, adjustable compression at the puncture site, the radial compression band is intended to support post-procedural care and help reduce the risk of access-site complications, such as hematoma formation, when used appropriately. Patient Comfort: An inflatable, transparent balloon enables gradual adjustment of compression, supporting patient comfort during use. Monitoring Capability: The transparent design allows visual observation of the access site for signs of bleeding or bruising while the device is in place. Fit and Adjustability: Two band lengths are available to support appropriate fi t across a range of patient anatomies.

Kimal PLC|kimal guidewire & guidewire di.description: All Kimal guidewires are nitinol to minimise kinking and are preloaded in the thumb wheel dispenser to help obtain smooth vascular access. The tip of the guidewire dispenser is designed to fit into the Altius® guidewire syringe for CVC placement. Grooved thumb wheel provides greater control when advancing whilst wearing gloves. The anti-slip groove ensures the guidewire stays centred under your thumb. Depth markings are indicated both on the guidewire dispenser and the guidewire. All Kimal guidewires are 50cm in length and range from 0.035″ (0.89mm) and 0.035″ (0.89mm) in gauge size. Kimal PLC|ic-flow™ imaging system.description: IC-Flow Imaging System is a small, compact, cost effective and easy to use handheld device that visualises and records tissue fluorescence. Kimal PLC|tidal high-flow needles.description: We’re pleased to announce that Tidal™ High-Flow Needles are now available to order from Kimal. Kimal PLC|verdye indocyanine green (icg).description: Verdye™ ICG is a fluorescence imaging product used by physicians to guide surgical and mapping procedures, based on fluorescence. Kimal PLC|tauropace™.description: How TauroPace™ can reduce CIED infections. The key active component in TauroPace™ is taurolidine, which works by preventing and disrupting biofilm formation. It inhibits microbial adhesion to surfaces and actively damages microbial cell membranes and associated toxins. 1 Taurolidine is a derivative of the amino acid taurine and functions as a broad-spectrum antimicrobial agent, demonstrating activity against a wide range of bacteria and fungi. 2 It is applied to disinfect accessible device components during implantation, revision, generator replacement, or extraction procedures. TauroPace TM a trademark of TauroPharm GmbH and is distributed by Kimal PLC only in the UK. 1. Wouters, Y., et al. (2018). Kimal PLC|smartport+ implantable port.description: SmartPort+ ® implantable ports give clinicians dependable, repeated vascular access for IV therapy, medication and fluid delivery, blood sampling, and power-injected Contrast-Enhanced CT (CECT) scanning. Featuring Endexo ® technology which provides a catheter material more resistant to the accumulation of blood components, and Vortex ® technology to eliminate dead spaces and sludge build up in the port chamber, SmartPort+ is designed to reduce occlusions and thrombosis, reduce overall interventions, and increase department efficiencies. Smart Angle identifier technology allows CT and CT Low-Profile power-injectable port models to be identified, with the CT engraving visible on chest X-ray or scout scan — helping you confirm power-injectable status quickly at the point of care. – Designed with patient outcomes in mind. A range of catheter materials and sizes, placement options, and port body styles gives clinicians more options to suit individual patient anatomy and treatment pathways. – Indication for use. The SmartPort+ ® is indicated for any patient requiring repeated vascular access, for delivery of medications, nutritional supplementation, fluids, blood, blood products, sampling of blood, and power injection of contrast media for imaging. SmartPort+ ® is a trademark of AngioDynamics, Inc. This information is intended for use by healthcare professionals only. Kimal PLC|sv bioflo midline.description: The BioFlo Midline Catheter with Endexo Technology provides safe and reliable short-term intravenous access Reduce Thrombus Accumulation by 94% 1 The surface modifying Endexo polymer is “blended” with the polyurethane catheter material making it more resistant to thrombus accumulation, a precursor of deep vein thrombosis and partial withdrawal occlusion. Inspiration Healthcare|blenderbuddy.description: BlenderBuddy 2 Ensure the blender is delivering an accurate mixture Every Blender Needs a Buddy The BlenderBuddy 2 attaches to a blender to simplify integrating an FiO2 analyzer or monitor through a universal DISS outlet port to provide added visibility of the delivered FiO 2 . It is equipped with a sample gas analysis port, enabling the placement of an oxygen analyzer to ensure the blender is delivering an accurate mixture. Confidence in what is being delivered It’s recommended and stated in literature from AARC(1) and the European Respiratory Society, that delivered gas should be checked by a calibrated analyzer frequently; Once a day in most instances. The BlenderBuddy 2 gives caregivers the ability to spot check prescribed gas easily and accurately. The built-in oxygen analysis port is upstream from the patient and other delivery systems. This keeps the oxygen analyzer free from humidity or other contaminants downstream. Integration Keeps Oxygen Delivery Set-Up in One Place With a combined set-up, the chances of equipment going missing are reduced since a completed set-up for oxygen delivery and analyzation are in one integrated solution. The dedicated oxygen analysis port and integrated flow meter keeps your equipment exactly where it needs to be; connected to the blender. Whether the blender is mounted on a wall or pole, allowing the products to be attached reduces the chance of pieces and parts being misplaced, ensuring everything that’s needed for O2 analysis stays in place. Inspiration Healthcare|inspire ncpap.description: Fresh gas is accelerated through small entrance tubes, it enters the internal chamber at a certain angle, allowing it to become unstable and to follow the path of least resistance. As the baby inhales, fresh gas is directed towards the infant. As inspiration ends, the flow is flipped around and leaves the generator through the expiratory tube effectively creating active expiration. The expiratory tube also acts as a reservoir of fresh gas, therefore should the infant’s peak flow demand rise above the delivered flow, gas will be entrained from the expiratory tube, allowing the infants peak flow requirement to be satisfied. Features nCPAP is proven to be beneficial in supporting infants with respiratory problems Comprehensive range of prongs and masks Masks and prongs are colour-coded for ease of recognition and use Designed using proven fluidic principles Simple fixation with bonnets to fit most infants Inspire generators are available with and without patient delivery circuits for greater flexibility

Inspiration Healthcare|algopedol® sucros.description: In conjunction with non-nutritive sucking, ALGOPEDOL® helps to calm and soothe preterm and term infants during painful procedures like: Arterial or venous blood draw, Blood sugar level test, immunization, Adhesive tape removal, Dressing change, weight check, X-Ray providing discomfort.

Inspiration Healthcare|the why?.description: rPAP TM Stabilisation. Skin-to-Skin. Success. Home rPAP TM Reimagined Closing the gap between international clinical guidelines and delivery room reality. The rPAP Re-imagined delivers a 12% absolute reduction in delivery room intubations [1], 92% lower Work of Breathing (WOB) [2], and a 2.4m reach for immediate family-centred care [3, 4], all by unleashing the potential of the infant warming infrastructure you already own. What is rPAP TM Reimagined? The rPAP Re-imagined is a hybrid respiratory device that seamlessly combines a premium nCPAP patient interface with the full capabilities of a delivery room resuscitator [3]. By incorporating a built-in resuscitation/PEEP valve port directly at the patient interface, it gives clinicians the unique ability to deliver manual backup inflation breaths instantly, using either nasal prongs or a standard face mask, without ever disrupting continuous, protective fluidic pressure [3]. The Why? 12% Reduction in Intubations Clinically proven to protect the transitional phase and deliver a 12% absolute reduction in delivery room intubation rates, keeping more infants stable at the mother’s side and avoiding unnecessary intensive care admissions [1]. 92% Lower Work of Breathing Powered by patented fluidic flip technology that actively assists expiration, dropping Imposed Work of Breathing (IWOB) by 92% compared to standard continuous-flow T-pieces to preserve the infant’s vital energy [2, 3]. 2.4-Metre Spatial Reach Engineered with a specialised 2.4-metre extended limb to close the physical gap in the delivery room, allowing clinicians to deliver gold-standard respiratory stabilisation directly on the mother’s chest or at the cord without maternal-infant separation [3, 4]. ILCOR Standard Alignment Fully aligned with international consensus guidelines by prioritising immediate, non-invasive nasal CPAP (nCPAP) support at birth over invasive intubation to protect fragile, developing neonatal lungs [5]. Eliminating the Face Mask Oxygen

Elekta|cervix.description: Brachytherapy for cervical cancer Brachytherapy is an essential component of treatment for cervical cancer, offering real advantages over other cervical cancer treatment options in terms of survival rates and side effects. Depending on the tumor stage, it can be performed with intracavitary or combined intracavitary/interstitial technique. On the basis of high-level evidence from randomized controlled trials, brachytherapy is indicated as standard in combination with chemoradiation in patients with locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC). Brachytherapy can be used alone in some cases of early-stage cervical cancers. Procedure What is the brachytherapy procedure for cervical cancer? Intracavitary brachytherapy is placed into the vagina (open cavity), close to the cervix uteri. Small radioactive sources precisely deliver radiation through an applicator and are completely removed after delivery, so no radioactivity will remain in the patients’ body. Modern brachytherapy uses Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) or Computed Tomography (CT) images to control the position of the tumor and the radioactive source. Continuous MR imaging reveals just how much the prostate moves and changes shape between and during fractions. This mobility challenges treatment accuracy and precision. While margins account for uncertainties, irradiation of healthy tissue can result in toxicity and associated side effects. Elekta Unity MR guided radiation therapy allows you to see the prostate and surrounding organs clearly as you treat, enabling you to respond to change and motion, and to adapt the plan for each patient and every fraction. With Elekta Unity you can: Reduce margins with certainty. Reduce number of fractions to 5. Preserve quality of life and erectile function. Elekta|pancreas.description: MR-guided radiation therapy (MRgRT) for pancreatic cancer Escalate dose with certainty Reduce margins to deliver ablative doses safely Pancreatic cancer has one of the lowest overall survival rates of any cancer 1 . Currently, the standard of care for inoperable pancreatic cancer involves the use of non-ablative radiation doses, since the high doses required to completely eradicate tumors are deemed unsafe using conventional CT-guidance. Elekta Unity supports the safe delivery of ablative radiation doses to pancreatic targets in just five sessions. MR-guided radiation therapy (MRgRT) enables you to see the tumor and surrounding OARs clearly for more accurate target delineation. With this superior soft tissue visualization and the ability to manage intrafraction motion, Elekta Unity allows the use of smaller margins–reducing dose to healthy tissue and supporting safe dose escalation. The delivery of ablative doses by MRgRT has been shown to provide excellent local control for patients with inoperable pancreatic cancer, offering them a safe and effective treatment alternative. Elekta|rectum.description: MR-guided online adaptive radiation therapy (MRgRT) for rectal cancer Preserve rectum with daily precision Safely escalate dose for organ preservation Treatment for rectal cancer typically involves a course of radiation therapy in combination with chemotherapy and/or surgery. Conventional, CBCT-based treatments provide limited image resolution at the time of treatment, requiring the use of large safety margins due to target and OAR motion. This also limits dose escalation and the potential for a complete pathological response. There is growing interest in MR-guided radiation therapy (MRgRT) to reduce RT-related toxicity and allow dose escalation approaches. This could increase the likelihood of complete clinical response and reduce the need for surgery. With Elekta Unity you can: Safely escalate dose to the tumor and consider more rectal cancer patients for organ preservation strategies. Elekta|skin ebx.description: Patient Resources: Skin eBx Electronic Brachytherapy Painless, Non-Surgical Non-Melanoma Skin Cancer Treatment One in five people will develop skin cancer in their lifetime, with more than 5.4 million cases diagnosed annually in the U.S. 1 The majority of cancers appear on sun exposed areas such as the face, scalp, nose, ears, hands, arms and legs. Xoft offers patients a non-invasive alternative to surgery for nonmelanoma (NMSC) treatment. With Elekta Xoft, painless, scar-free treatment of NMSC is possible with skin eBx (electronic brachytherapy), a form of high dose rate, low energy radiation therapy delivered in minutes over a short series of office visits. While surgery is considered to be the standard of care for NMSC, for some patients, surgery is not an option or a preference. Skin eBx is particularly ideal in treating anatomically challenging locations, such as the face, scalp, nose, ears, arms and legs, as well as areas prone to difficulties in wound healing. Skin eBx may also be the preferred option for patients who are not surgical candidates due to medical comorbidities, or patients with higher-risk lesions requiring adjunct therapy to surgery. In addition to providing a highly effective, non-surgical treatment option for NMSC, Elekta Xoft Surface Applicator are also suitable for intraoperative radiation therapy (IORT) applications. Elekta|2023 american college of veterina.description: 2023 American College of Veterinary Radiology (ACVR) Treatment Plan Study September 13, 2023 2 minute read ProKnow is proud to support the annual meeting of the American College of Veterinary Radiology (ACVR) by hosting our first ever Veterinary Treatment Plan Study . The technology used for this study will be our ProKnow Systems plan study program . Quick Facts Patient The patient is a 12-year-old neutered male Golden Retriever cross with a diagnosis of a heart base tumor. Prescription 30 Gy in 3 fractions (10 Gy/fraction). Plan Quality Plan quality calculations will be based on 27 scored target and OAR metrics, plus two non-scored plan metrics (beams and MUs). Plan Study Leaders The study is designed and led by a team from the University of Saskatchewan , led by Dr. Monique Mayer, DVM, MS, DACVR (RO). Who Can Participate? Any and all veterinary clinicians who treat with radiation therapy are encouraged to participate. In addition, radiation therapy experts who treat only humans are also invited to submit plans! After all, photons are photons and living souls are living souls, so please participate. We have a lot to learn from each other. Important Dates September 12, 2023 Plan st

CliniMed|tensi+ conductive gel.description: Tensi+ Conductive Gel is designed to be used with the Tensi+ medical device to help the electrodes make good contact with the skin. This helps ensure the electrical stimulation is delivered comfortably and consistently throughout the 20-minute treatment.

CliniMed|tensi+.description: Tensi+ is an innovative, non-medicinal treatment option for people living with overactive bladder. During a simple 20-minute daily treatment, the device is placed comfortably at the ankle to deliver gentle electrical stimulation to the posterior tibial nerve. This stimulation may help improve bladder control and improve quality of life.

CliniMed|clinishield® advance 360° foam.product: CliniShield® Advance 360° Foam & Spray Skin Cleanser
CliniMed|clinishield® advance 360° foam.description: Gently cleanses the skin . The cost-effective CliniShield Advance 360° Foam & Spray Skin Cleanser features innovative 360-degree technology that allows the skin cleanser to be discharged at any angle, including completely upside down. This functionality is a significant advantage for reaching difficult areas or assisting users with limited mobility. The device further enhances care through its dual-application modes: the foam mode provides a dense, localised texture ideal for managing heavy soiling while the spray mode offers a lighter, broader application suited for lighter cleaning and routine hygiene. The product may be used on adults and children.

CliniMed|clinishield® advance protective.description: Protects your skin. Prevents soreness. Preserves skin integrity. Our cost-effective CliniShield Advance Protective Barrier Cream offers protection for intact and injured skin prone to moisture damage. It is indicated for use in incontinence care, protecting skin from exposure to urine, faeces, and other bodily fluids. The protective barrier cream provides long-lasting, waterproof protection for up to 24 hours – perfect for soothing soreness from incontinence or skin folds. Its gentle formula ensures it will not block continence pads, so they stay fully absorbent. The protective barrier cream moisturises and provides a protective barrier restoring the skin’s hydration. The product may be used on adults and children.

CliniMed|aura® 2 two-piece urostomy.description: Double the security. The Aura 2 Urostomy pouch connects to the Aura 2 Urostomy flange with a coupling system, with the extra benefit of an adhesive ring which provides additional security. With flat and convex flanges available, there’s an option which will ensure your secure and discreet two-piece fit. Our Aura 2 Urostomy flanges are specifically designed for urostomates, offering enhanced durability whilst still being flexible and comfortable. Promoting skin health. The skin-friendly Hyperflex ® hydrocolloid flange contains medical grade Manuka honey which may help promote healthy skin around the stoma. Made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, Aura 2 provides reliable adhesion which is still kind and gentle for your skin. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Designed for incorporation into your daily life. With a super soft, water-repellent cover for comfortable wear and a split-back cover for simple application and monitoring of output, Aura 2 is designed to enhance your stoma care routine and to give you peace of mind throughout the day.

CliniMed|curan® gel catheters.description: Ease and comfort for self-catheterisation. Curan Gel intermittent catheters are designed with user comfort and convenience in mind. The hydrogel coating ensures a smooth insertion, minimising discomfort and mess. These compact catheters come in a handy portable case, making them perfect for life on the go. Hydrogel coating. The gel coating means the catheter is ready to use right out of the portable case, no mess, no preparation needed. The easy twist and grip lid is a great choice for users with limited manual dexterity. Offering you choice. For those users who don’t tolerate hydrophilic catheters well, the gel coating offers, a gentle DEHP free alternative. All catheters in the Curan Gel range come in a box of 30 single use catheters. The catheters and packaging are made from recyclable material, however, once used, as the catheter is contaminated it is recommended that they are disposed of in the household waste.

CliniMed|instillaquill®.description: The narrower distal part of Instillaquill makes it suitable for use in both multiparous and nulliparous women, whilst the adjacent collar acts as a guide to the length of tube inserted into the cervical canal.

CliniMed|instillagel®.description: Active ingredients Each 100 grams contains: Lidocaine Hydrochloride (Local anaesthetic) 2.000g Chlorhexidine Gluconate Solution (Antiseptic) 0.250g Methyl Hydroxybenzoate (E218) (Antiseptic) 0.060g Propyl Hydroxybenzoate (E216) (Antiseptic) 0.025g In a gel made with Hydroxyethylcellulose, Propylene Glycol and Purified Water. The gel comes in disposable syringes each containing either 6ml or 11ml. Before Instillagel is used Tell the person preparing to use the gel if any of the following applies to you: Do not use Instillagel: If you are allergic (hypersensitive) to lidocaine, chlorhexidine, methyl hydroxybenzoate, propyl hydrobenzonate or any of other ingredients of Instillagel If the moist lining of the application site is damaged or bleeding Care should be taken when using Instillagel: If you have heart problems If you have liver problems If you are epileptic Pregnancy and breastfeeding Tell the person preparing to use the gel if you are pregnant or think you might be pregnant. You can continue to breast-feed. Has the gel any side effects? You might feel a slight stinging just after the gel is used, but this stops as soon as the anaesthetic starts to work. Most people find that there are no problems after the gel has been used but there may be a slight soreness when the effect of the local anaesthetic has worn off. If you feel that you have had any reaction to the gel, please tell your doctor as soon as possible.
features: If you are allergic (hypersensitive) to lidocaine, chlorhexidine, methyl hydroxybenzoate, propyl hydrobenzonate or any of other ingredients of Instillagel
If the moist lining of the application site is damaged or bleeding

CliniMed|appeel® sterile medical adhesiv.description: Unique range to help reduce skin trauma during adhesive dressing removal. The removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings is not only associated with increased nursing time due to the pain, anxiety and difficulty it can cause, but repeated application and removal can also cause damage and result in medical adhesive related skin injuries (MARSIs) such as skin stripping and can also increase the risk of infection. Appeel Sterile Medical Adhesive Remover is designed for quick and easy removal of medical adhesive devices and dressings, preventing MARSIs, reducing pain and the risk of infection. It can be used on intact and injured skin and is ideal for those with fragile skin such as babies and the elderly, or for blistering conditions like epidermolysis bullosa. Evidence shows that the inert fluid in Appeel Sterile Medical Adhesive Remover is not metabolised by the skin, ensuring that it is safe to use on injured skin and will not impact wound healing¹. All Appeel Sterile products are made of healthcare-grade silicones which are no-sting (alcohol-free) and dry quickly leaving no residue. This allows for adhesive medical devices and dressings to be re-applied shortly after use. 1 CliniMed data on file, 2010

CliniMed|appeel® no sting medical adhesi.product: Appeel® No Sting Medical Adhesive Remover
CliniMed|appeel® no sting medical adhesi.description: The repeated application and removal of stoma pouches and their accessories can lead to peristomal skin damage and pain. Use of Appeel Advance Medical Adhesive Remover helps to protect skin, whilst reducing the risk of damaging peristomal skin or experiencing pain from repeated stoma bag changes. Appeel Advance is a product within stoma care for assisting in the removal of stoma bags. It is available in individual wipes and a spray that can be used at any angle.

CliniMed|clinisorb®.description: Wound malodour can cause unnecessary distress to the patient and carer. Malodour occurs as a result of bacterial metabolism and the production of volatile fatty acids. Activated charcoal dressings such as CliniSorb adsorb these toxins thus removing the malodour from the wound. CliniSorb can be used to control odour for a range of wounds such as, pressure ulcers, leg ulcers, diabetic foot and fungating wounds. It can be used in both moderately and lightly exuding wounds. Traditionally it has been believed that CliniSorb should only be used as a secondary dressing and that its effectiveness would be reduced when it became wet. Hampton¹ concluded from a pilot study carried out on 20 patients that those nurses who used CliniSorb as a primary layer commented that malodour either improved or remained the same. Therefore using CliniSorb as a primary layer does not affect the malodour controlling properties of the charcoal dressing. ¹Hampton S April (2003) Reducing malodour in wounds: A dressing evaluation journal of community nursing volume 17, Issue 4

CliniMed|clinishield® advance no sting b.product: CliniShield® Advance No Sting Barrier Film Range
CliniMed|clinishield® advance no sting b.description: Protects your skin. Prevents soreness. Prepares skin surface. Skin contact with an adhesive appliance can leave the skin red and sore. The CliniShield Advance Barrier Film range protects your skin for up to 48 hours. By applying CliniShield Advance, you’ll create a waterproof barrier over your skin, keeping it safe from damage. CliniShield Advance creates a smooth, dry surface for the adhesive appliances to adhere to. This can improve the seal and potentially extend wear time by reducing leaks and the need for frequent changes. By creating a barrier and reducing irritation, CliniShield Advance can help maintain a healthy skin environment, which is crucial for healing and preventing further skin breakdown. The CliniShield Advance Range was specially formulated as an affordable option, providing quality care without stretching NHS budgets.

CliniMed|lbf® sterile barrier film range.description: Protecting the skin is a complicated process that is often taken for granted until damage occurs. LBF Sterile Barrier Film provides a protective barrier against the harmful effects of bodily fluids such as wound exudate and excessive perspiration, which can cause maceration and irritation. It also helps to protect against pressure, friction and shear which can lead to the formation of pressure ulcers, as well as adhesive trauma caused by the repeated removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings. LBF Sterile Barrier Film dries rapidly on the skin, forming a breathable, long-lasting transparent barrier which helps to preserve skin integrity. The fluid remains sterile for each application, making it suitable for use on both intact and injured skin.

CliniMed|lbf® barrier cream.description: Protecting the skin is a complicated process that is often taken for granted until damage occurs. LBF Barrier Cream moisturises the skin whilst providing a protective barrier against the harmful effects of bodily fluids such as wound exudate and excessive perspiration, which can cause maceration and irritation. The cream is a skin-friendly formulation suitable for intact skin. The waterproof formulation offers long-lasting protection and will not block incontinence pad absorbency. The cream’s balanced consistency makes it easy to apply and spread across the skin, which maximises coverage and reduces application time. Its highly concentrated formula covers a large area of skin, so a little cream goes a long way. It also helps to protect against pressure, friction and shear which can lead to the formation of pressure ulcers. LBF Barrier Cream is ideal for fragile skin as the barrier helps to prevent adhesive trauma and skin stripping caused by the repeated removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings.

CliniMed|clinipeel® medical adhesive rem.description: The CliniPeel Medical Adhesive Removers spray (non-fragranced) and wipes contain silicone which effortlessly releases adhesive appliances such as stoma pouches and urinary sheaths from the skin to reduce skin trauma and pain. It’s fast drying, leaving no residue on the skin, which allows adhesive appliances to be re-applied shortly after use. It helps maintain skin integrity whilst assisting quick and easy adhesive appliance removal. Stoma pouch removal with CliniPeel Mint 2-in-1 The CliniPeel Medical Adhesive Remover Mint spray also contains silicone which aids in the quick and easy removal of stoma pouches. For an even fresher feel, try CliniPeel Mint 2-in-1, delicately scented with pure peppermint oil. The added fresh peppermint scent helps mask odours between pouch changes and eliminates the need for an additional deodoriser. Our CliniPeel Range of skin care products are cost-effective without compromising on quality and are able to provide a cost saving to the NHS.

CliniMed|hyperseal mouldable seals with.product: HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey
CliniMed|hyperseal mouldable seals with.description: HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey seal the gap between the stoma and the skin around the stoma, providing extra security when the pouch is applied. They are flexible and mouldable, so help to fill in dips and creases around the stoma. Skin friendly Gentle and nurturing, Manuka honey provides additional comfort and is kind to the skin around the stoma. The hydrocolloid is made from all natural ingredients, without any preservatives or tackifiers, so provides gentle but reliable adhesion around uneven stoma areas. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Versatile and adaptable HyperSeal moulds around all body contours. They can be stretched, shaped, moulded, or cut to fit around the stoma, ensuring a secure fit. Long-lasting adhesion HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey maintain their stickiness and can be re-joined if they break, providing reliable adhesion and maintaining effectiveness to provide security for the stoma pouch.

CliniMed|welland® stoma paste.description: Gentle and effective. Welland Stoma Paste is alcohol-free and hypoallergenic, ensuring it won’t cause stinging or irritation upon application. It’s suitable for most skin types, providing comfort and peace of mind. Smooth and secure seal. Its unique formula smooths and levels minor skin irregularities, creating a perfect base for your stoma bag. By creating this perfect seal, the risk of leaks behind the flange is reduced, preventing related skin irritation and damage. Easy application. The soft, squeezable tube makes applying Welland Stoma Paste effortless. It remains pliable throughout application, allowing for flexibility in moulding and smoothing over scar lines. Long-lasting performance. Welland Stoma Paste offers durable and long-lasting performance, providing a secure hold for your stoma bag throughout the day. Its reliable adhesion prevents leakage and helps prevent sore skin, promoting overall comfort and confidence. Compatibility. Compatible with both one-piece and two-piece stoma pouches and systems, Welland Stoma Paste is versatile and adaptable to various ostomy care routines. This compatibility ensures it can be seamlessly integrated into your preferred stoma care routine.

CliniMed|aura® plus soft convex urostomy.description: For flush or recessed stomas that need gentle support to help bring the stoma out into the pouch. Suitable for people whose stoma sits level with or below the skin, or who have skin creases and folds that can make getting a secure fit more challenging. CliniMed|limone® deodorant spray.description: If your stoma pouch fits well, there should be no smell except when changing it but, if you are worried about the smell lingering, Limone ostomy deodorant spray can provide peace of mind. Effective odour management. Unique formula neutralises odours rather than simply masking them with heavy scents. Refreshing fragrance. Each spray releases a refreshing lemon and lime fragrance, neutralising odour with a natural and light scent. Accessible solution. Limone comes in a simple to use spray can which can be used at any angle.

CliniMed|morform® motion management sach.description: Morform Motion Management Sachets are specially formulated for dealing with very liquid output. Whether you’re at home or travelling, Morform helps control your stoma output, reducing pouch bulging, minimising discomfort and managing noise.

CliniMed|hydroframe® flange extenders wi.product: HydroFrame® Flange Extenders with Manuka Honey
CliniMed|hydroframe® flange extenders wi.description: Additional adhesion to secure your pouch. Whether you’re putting extra pressure on your flange whilst gardening or doing the housework, or whether you need extra support around creases, skin-folds or hernias, HydroFrame can provide the extra security you need to keep your flange in place and reduce the risk of leaks. Infused with Manuka honey. The skin-friendly hydrocolloid contains medical grade Manuka honey, which is known for its therapeutic properties and may help to promote healthy skin around the stoma. HydroFrame is made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, providing reliable but gentle adhesion with less risk of trauma when removing the extender. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Choose your preferred size. Also available as a smaller Mini version, great for smaller areas where adhesion is required or for use as an alternative to more aggressive medical tape.

CliniMed|ultraframe® flange extenders.description: UltraFrame is a flange extender designed to be applied over the edges of your stoma pouch, providing extra security and preventing the edges of the pouch from lifting. Great for active ostomates or anyone putting their pouch to the test. When security matters most. UltraFrame Film Flange Extenders offer additional security precisely when you need it. Whether you’re hitting the gym or enjoying water-based activities, UltraFrame keeps your flange securely in place, providing peace of mind throughout the day. Discreet protection. With its unique ultra-thin, low-profile, and transparent film, UltraFrame ensures discreet protection under clothing and when the pouch is exposed. You can even view the condition of the skin underneath, giving you confidence in your ostomy care routine. Withstand the pressures of everyday. UltraFrame’s waterproof design maintains integrity and shape even when in contact with water, making it ideal for bathing, swimming, and active lifestyles. Comfortable wear. Experience comfort like never before with UltraFrame. The smooth and lightweight film allows the skin underneath to breathe, acting and feeling like a second skin. You’ll forget it’s even there, allowing you to focus on living life to the fullest.

CliniMed|aura® stoma cap.description: Confidence in every detail. Aura Stoma Cap provides peace of mind with its discreet design and reliable performance. Much smaller than a standard stoma bag, it’s ideal for short-term wear, offering protection during everyday activities, sports, and water-based activities. Comfort and convenience. Designed for comfort, Aura Stoma Cap features an integral absorbent pad to absorb leaks and protect the stoma during various activities. Lightweight and convenient, it ensures discretion during bathing, showering, swimming, and intimate moments. Ideal for use following irrigation, it offers a discreet alternative between scheduled irrigations. Meet your need for comfort and discretion. Aura Stoma Cap features a hydrocolloid flange infused with medical-grade Manuka honey for enhanced comfort and skin protection. Its improved Dual-Carb® 2 filter provides superior deodorisation, ensuring confidence throughout the day. With an easy-to-read flange cutting guide for a secure fit and a super-soft backing for comfortable wear time, Aura Stoma Cap with Manuka Honey is designed to give you the confidence and freedom to live life to the fullest. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety.

CliniMed|aura® convex urostomy.description: Suits your convexity needs. The Aura Convex Urostomy bag offers a straightforward solution designed to accommodate various convexity needs. Whether your stoma is retracted, recessed, sunken, tilted, flushed, or poorly sited, this bag provides a reliable option for a secure and comfortable fit. Enhanced security. Featuring a soft domed flange that can be folded during application, Aura Convex Urostomy ensures a secure fit. The versatile flange moulds to the contours of your stoma creating a reliable seal against leakage. Integrated belt loops and an optional easy-to-use belt offer added reassurance to provide extra security when you need it. Comfort. Infused with medical grade Manuka honey, the hydrocolloid flange is designed to offer exceptional comfort and may help to promote healthy skin around your stoma. The unique Hyperflex® hydrocolloid allows the skin to breathe while maintaining a reliable seal. The Easy2Peel™ tab supports smooth flange removal, minimising skin trauma. Furthermore, the super soft and water-repellent cover prioritises comfort, even during extended wear. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Range of sizes. Available in a range of pouch sizes from Midi to Maxi to suit your preferences for capacity and the profile of your pouch. Also available in 3 convex plateau sizes ranging from 25mm to 48mm. Important Note: Please consult a stoma care nurse before using convexity stoma pouches to ensure suitability for your specific needs.

CliniMed|aura® profile urostomy.description: Flexible protection. Aura Profile Urostomy features a flange that adjusts to the shape of a parastomal hernia and moulds around the contours of the body, ensuring a secure, leak-free fit. It can adapt to different body shapes and helps to fill in features like dips or scars. Skin-friendly. Infused with medical-grade Manuka honey, the flange may help to promote healthy skin around the stoma. Made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, the hydrocolloid provides reliable adhesion while remaining gentle and breathable. This means reliable security with less risk of skin irritation or damage. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Comfort and convenience. Aura Profile Urostomy comes with an Easy2Peel™ tab for easy removal, reducing the risk of pain or skin damage when it’s time to change your pouch. With a soft and water-repellent cover, Aura Profile keeps you comfortable all day long whilst remaining resistant to the stresses of everyday life. Available in a wide range of sizes. Whether you prefer a Midi or Maxi pouch, Aura Profile has an option for you. You can also choose between inverted plateau sizes which range from 25mm to 48mm. The plateau is the part of the flange which inverts to mould around your body, and the size depends on your stoma size and the surrounding area of your stoma that you’re supporting. Extra security when you need it most. Integrated belt loops which are compatible with the FreeStyle Vie belt and other belt systems, so you can provide extra security to your pouch.

The versatile flange moulds to the contours of your stoma creating a reliable seal against leakage. Integrated belt loops and an optional easy-to-use belt offer added reassurance to provide extra security when you need it. Comfort. Infused with medical grade Manuka honey, the hydrocolloid flange is designed to offer exceptional comfort and may help to promote healthy skin around your stoma. The unique Hyperflex® hydrocolloid allows the skin to breathe while maintaining a reliable seal. The Easy2Peel™ tab supports smooth flange removal, minimising skin trauma. Furthermore, the super soft and water-repellent cover promotes comfort, even during extended wear. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Range of sizes. Available in a range of pouch sizes from Mini to Maxi to suit your preferences for for capacity and the profile of your pouch. Also available in 4 convex plateau sizes ranging from 25mm to 60mm. Important Note: Please consult a stoma care nurse before using convexity stoma pouches to ensure suitability for your specific needs.

CliniMed|aura® profile closed.description: Flexible protection. Aura Profile Closed features a flange that adjusts to the shape of a parastomal hernia and moulds around the contours of the body, ensuring a secure, leak-free fit. It can adapt to different body shapes and helps to fill in features like dips or scars. Skin-friendly. Infused with medical-grade Manuka honey, the flange may help to promote healthy skin around the stoma. Made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, the hydrocolloid provides reliable adhesion while remaining gentle and breathable. This means reliable security with less risk of skin irritation or damage. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Comfort and convenience. Aura Profile Closed comes with an Easy2Peel™ tab for easy removal, reducing the risk of pain or skin damage when it’s time to change your pouch. With a soft and water-repellent cover, Aura Profile keeps you comfortable all day long whilst remaining resistant to the stresses of everyday life. Available in a wide range of sizes. Whether you prefer a Mini, Midi or Maxi pouch, Aura Profile has an option for you. You can also choose between plateau sizes which range from 25mm to 60mm. The plateau is the part of the flange which inverts to mould around your body, and the size depends on your stoma size and the surrounding area of your stoma that you’re supporting. Extra security when you need it most. Integrated belt loops which are compatible with the FreeStyle Vie belt and other belt systems, so you can provide extra security to your pouch.

CliniMed|aura® closed.description: Designed with skin health in mind. Featuring our renowned Hyperflex ® hydrocolloid flange infused with medical grade Manuka honey which may promote healthy skin around your stoma. The hydrocolloid is made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, offering reliable adhesion whilst still being gentle and kind to skin, reducing the risk of pain or trauma when it’s time to change your pouch. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Reliable features to make life easier. Our Dual-Carb ® 2 filter enhances deodorisation and reduces ballooning. The release liner has a release tab for quick and simple removal also has an easy to read cutting guide to help you cut the flange to the exact size and shape of your stoma for starter hole options. A secure fit for reliable protection. A large flange shape for security and advanced adhesion, helping you achieve a perfect leak-free fit. Convenient design. Changing your pouch is made effortless with the handy Easy2Peel™ feature, allowing for quick and hassle-free removal. The super soft water-repellent cover ensures extended wear time without compromising on comfort. Additionally, the split back design facilitates easy application and convenient monitoring of output. A versatile range of sizes to suit your preferences. Available in three sizes and two discreet colour options, beige or clear, this closed colostomy bag caters to your individual needs.

CliniMed|aura® flushable.description: Simple disposal. The inner liner of the pouch, which contains your output, and the flange which adheres to your skin, can be effortlessly flushed down the toilet. Just separate the outer cover, which is completely clean and can be disposed of in a standard bin when convenient, then remove and flush the inner liner and flange with your output. Aura Flushable is proven not to block the toilet or drainline¹. Enhanced confidence and freedom. Aura Flushable empowers you to regain any confidence and freedom lost following colostomy surgery. No need to worry about pouch disposal, now you can effortlessly change your pouch even while on the go. Flexible disposal options. The inner liner and flange of Aura Flushable can be flushed together or easily separated, giving you the flexibility to choose your preferred disposal method. Some people prefer to remove the flange from the inner liner, either flushing it separately for extra peace of mind or disposing of it in the bin along with the outer cover. Skin-friendly design. The flange is made of our unique skin-friendly Hyperflex® hydrocolloid, which includes medical grade Manuka honey which may help to promote healthy skin around the stoma. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Available in a range of sizes. Choose between three pouch sizes, Mini, Midi and Maxi. Available with a starter hole which can be cut to fit the exact size and shape of your stoma, or in a range of pre-cut flange options. 1 DATA ON FILE. WRC INDEPENDENT TESTING 2017

A: At the start it is common to irrigate once every day for the first 10-14 days. Later on, the frequency may possibly be reduced to once every other day or every third day. The frequency should be decided in consultation with a healthcare professional. Q: Can I stop using stool modifying medicine when I start using Navina Irrigation System? A: TAI is usually part of a bowel management program. It is possible that you may be able to reduce the amount of laxative they are using eventually but you may have to continue using some to ensure that the stools have the right consistency to ensure easy evacuation. It is best to continue with your current laxative regimen until you are getting regular results from TAI. Consult a healthcare professional before changing your personal regimen. Wellspect|medical issue.description: Symptoms questions in conjunction with irrigation. Q: What if bleeding should occur? A: A small amount of bleeding or smearing of blood on the cone may occur and should not alarm you. More severe or sustained rectal bleeding with or without pain suggests a possible bowel perforation, which should be treated as a medical emergency and requires immediate medical attention. Q: What should I do if I feel pain? A: If cramps, discomfort, or pain occur while instilling the water, pause instillation for a few moments and continue more slowly once the discomfort has subsided, ensure that the water is warm enough, at body temperature. If pain is severe or persistent stop the irrigation immediately. It could be perforation of the bowel which should be treated as a medical emergency. Q: What if I feel sweating, palpitations or dizziness during irrigation? A: If you have a spinal cord injury this may be a sign of autonomic dysreflexia. Instill the water slowly and limit the time on the toilet depending on tolerance. Wellspect|instillation.description: Water and device questions related to instillation. Q: Why can’t I get from priming to instillation with my Navina Smart? A: Occasionally small amounts of water can get trapped inside the Navina Smart control unit. To prevent this from happening, make sure to always follow the order of the disassembly instructions given in the IFU (disconnect tubes before pressing the power-button on the unit). If the unit is already stuck in priming mode, try placing the water container higher than the catheter and squeezing the water container gently during the priming step. This increases the water flow and may dislodge the trapped water. Q: How much water should I instill? ADULTS: A healthcare professional will advise you how much water should be used. Timesco Healthcare Ltd|neurolight pupill.description: The NeuroLight Pupillometer elevates neurological assessment with its non-invasive and objective approach. This innovative tool automates pupillometry, a crucial technique for evaluating neurological function. By providing accurate measurements of pupil size and light reflex, NeuroLight empowers clinicians to gain early insights into a patient’s neurological state. This translates to faster diagnosis, more informed treatment decisions, and ultimately, improved patient outcomes. The portable pupilometer features an easy-to-use interface and a comfortable, reusable eye cup. It precisely measures pupil size and response time, converting them into a clear QPI score. This allows for the identification of potential neurological issues, with patient data being logged, tracked and transferable for further analysis. Learn More Read Support Literature Pupil Reactivity Assessment with NeuroLight QPI Score This chart translates pupillary response, measured by the NeuroLight device, into a clear and objective QPI score (Quantitative Pupillometry Index). Score Range Red – 0-1-2: Non-Reactive / Weak – May suggest significant neurological dysfunction. Orange – 3: Reduced – May indicate potential neurological issues. Green – 4-5: Good / Very Good – Considered normal pupillary response. Product No Product Description NPC Code D85.500 Neurolight Pupilometer N/A

Medstrom|aria turn+ therapy.description: Introducing an exclusive, all-in-one support package designed to elevate outcomes in repositioning, tissue viability, and mobilisation. The Aria Turn+ Therapy System creates a truly unmatched solution for the care of plus-size patients. This package is exclusive to Medstrom and is designed to overcome the most common challenges in clinical practice, enabling caregivers to get closer to the patient, simplify complex repositioning tasks, and support safer, more dignified mobilisation.

Medstrom|vela xl extra-wide stretcher.description: The Vela XL Stretcher is a versatile extra-wide stretcher supporting improved patient care throughout a hospital stay.

Medstrom|aria lateral tilt bed and dolph.product: Aria Lateral Tilt Bed and Dolphin Therapy
Medstrom|aria lateral tilt bed and dolph.description: This unique bed and surface duo combines full platform lateral tilt and exceptional immersion. It offers an ideal solution for the most complex patients, in both critical care and general ward environments. In addition to outstanding pressure area care, benefits include easier patient repositioning and care, and improved caregiver efficiency.

Medstrom|aer magna.description: Designed with both safety and convenience in mind, the AER Magna is a bariatric dynamic air mattress with an adjustable width from 90 to 120cm. Combined with the Versatech 1100, the AER Magna provides effective protection against pressure ulcers while maintaining patient comfort and dignity.

Medstrom|protecta luxe.description: Designed for full compatibility with the Medstrom Solo Luxe bed frame, the advanced construction of the Protecta Luxe offers enhanced skin and pressure ulcer protection for a wide variety of patients.

Medstrom|protecta 7.description: For a growing patient population with complex mental and physical problems, there’s a need for mattress solutions that prioritise safety without compromising on clinical outcomes. The Protecta 7 has been specifically designed as a solution to these challenges, providing enhanced skin protection in even the most high-risk scenarios.

Medstrom|medstrom solo luxe.description: Uniquely suitable for children, adults and adults with atypical anatomy, the Solo Luxe offers enhanced protection and safety for all.

Medstrom|eco shower.description: It’s time for change. The ECO portable patient shower is the future of patient hygiene, utilising innovative hydro-molecular technology. The result? Patient dignity and experience restored, up to 65% reduction in caregiver time and up to 95% water reduction than a traditional bed bath.
