Medstrom|dolphin therapy: the gift of co.description: .product_title {color: #e9af32 !important;} .woocommerce div.product div.summary .product_meta .button, .woocommerce-page div.product div.summary .product_meta .button {color: #fff; border: 1px solid #fff;} Our gift from us to you is consistent and evidenced outcomes with Dolphin Therapy.

Medstrom|from us, to you.description: .product_title {color: #e9af32 !important;} .woocommerce div.product div.summary .product_meta .button, .woocommerce-page div.product div.summary .product_meta .button {color: #fff; border: 1px solid #fff;} Our gift from us to you is a promise of 24/7/365 reliable support with an innovative and clinically evidenced specialist rental portfolio, supporting improved and consistent patient outcomes this festive season.

Medstrom|360 care+ package.description: The 360Care+ Package is an innovative rental package that provides effective falls management and safe mobilisation, increases nursing efficiency and improves patient outcomes.

Medstrom|be equipped with medstrom.description: As the temperatures drop, Medstrom is here to support with escalation preparation.

Medstrom|versatech 1100.description: With an established range of bariatric equipment, including two known and widely used bed frames, Medstrom is delighted to exclusively introduce the Versatech 1100 bariatric bed to its growing portfolio, significantly adding to the solutions available. The Versatech 1100 is a width adjustable, ultra-low bed with a high safe working load of 500kg and additional high specification benefits such as Class III weigh scales, bed exit alarms and a range of electric profiling functionality.

Medstrom|aria cushion.description: The Medstrom Aria cushion is designed to be ultra-portable and compact, with its own control unit accompanied by a 12-hour battery life to acknowledge the drawbacks with traditional systems. Equipped with an ultra-low profile of just 6.5cm and innovative cubed cells, the cushion ensures safe mobilisation to and from a chair without compromising on therapeutic benefits.

Medstrom|riser recliner pro.description: The Riser Recliner PRO is the latest advancement in riser recliner functionality, achieving a bespoke seating solution for every patient. UK manufactured and available in different widths from 20” through to 38”, the PRO range has been specially adapted to deliver reassuring stability and support, helping to promote early patient mobilisation.

Medstrom|medstrom solo+.description: A unique and highly versatile hospital bed with an unrivalled height range for maximum patient and caregiver safety.

Medstrom|if you’re working, we’re workin.description: Medstrom is here to support you over the festive period with specialist product rental, equipped with round-the-clock clinical and technical support.

Medstrom|medstrom aria junior.description: Discover the Aria Junior, specifically designed for paediatrics, providing optimal therapy and immersion whilst enhancing comfort.

Medstrom|medstrom aria flex.description: Discover the advanced semi-dynamic support surface that offers immediate protection from pressure ulcers and behaves like a dynamic mattress, even in non-powered mode.

Medstrom|calibre mobile hoist.description: The Oxford Calibre is an ergonomically designed mobile patient hoist for the safe lifting of plus-size patients. Sturdy and robust, with a safe working load of 385kg (60 stone), it is specifically designed to meet the unique demands of bariatric care.

Medstrom|pro-bario active.description: The Pro-Bario Active bed is designed for plus-size users living at home with complex needs. The wide sleep platform provides comfort and support to the user, and the electric controls help protect caregivers from manual handling injury. This bariatric bed is safely assembled inside the user’s home by qualified technicians, easy to clean and durable. A range of compatible surfaces and accessories is available.

Medstrom|medstrom solomh.description: Understanding the risks involved in safeguarding both clients and caregivers, the SoloMH bed is an innovative four-section, electric profiling bed frame that has several adaptations to optimise safety and provide enhanced protection.

Medstrom|optima juve.description: Optima Juve is a therapeutic support system suitable for both the treatment of existing pressure ulcers category I-IV as well as for children who have been assessed to be at high risk from complications of immobility. The surface compromises two layers of air cells, with the top layer being pre-filled to allow greater immersion. The closed air system automatically adjusts to individual patient weight, providing excellent pressure redistribution.

Medstrom|eleganza 5 bed and dolphin ther.description: A unique combination of full platform lateral tilt with unrivalled immersion. This helps improve outcomes, enhance patient care, and increase caregiver efficiency, both inside and outside intensive care.

Medstrom|dolphin therapy paediatric.description: Clinically and technologically advanced fluid immersion simulation therapy has transformed the prevention and treatment of pressure ulcers for the most complex patients.

Medstrom|p.r.o. matt plus.description: Equipped with a unique and patented valve system and semi-dynamic technology, P.R.O. Matt Plus in non-powered mode, is able to achieve a pressure profile similar to that of a dynamic air mattress. This offers significantly higher therapy than a foam mattress and a traditional hybrid system and means patients are protected immediately. If the patient requires a ‘step up’, cell-in-cell technology allows a control unit to be added, converting the system to powered therapy and uniquely offering both alternating and continuous low pressure.

Medstrom|dolphin therapy extra-wide.description: Dolphin Therapy extra-wide, suitable for bariatric beds, is the ideal choice of surface for complex and difficult-to-manage plus-size patients.

Medstrom|turncair 1000.description: The TurnCair 1000 low air loss bariatric mattress provides a high specification of support surface for pressure redistribution, plus a TurnAssist feature that enables safe handling of patients. The TurnAssist feature facilitates easy manual handling for personal care and positional changes, easy changes of linen, inserting slide sheets and positional changes that can be carried out with one nurse.

Medstrom|p.r.o. matt plus extra-wide.description: Equipped with a unique and patented valve system and semi-dynamic technology, P.R.O. Matt Plus Extra-Wide in non-powered mode, is able to achieve a pressure profile similar to that of a dynamic air mattress. This offers significantly higher therapy than a foam mattress and a traditional hybrid system and means patients are protected immediately. If the patient requires a ‘step up’, cell-in-cell technology allows a control unit to be added, converting the system to powered therapy and uniquely offering both alternating and continuous low pressure.

Medstrom|neo.description: The Neo is one of the only surfaces available specifically designed for neonates that have been compromised and at high risk of skin breakdown. The intelligent controller registers individual patient weight to provide a reactive support surface, even for the smallest of babies. Two versions available for compatibility with incubators and infant warmers.

Medstrom|turncair.description: The TurnCair low air loss mattress provides a high specification of support surface for pressure redistribution, plus a TurnAssist feature that enables safe handling of patients. The TurnAssist feature facilitates easy manual handling for personal care and positional changes, easy changes of linen, inserting slide sheets and positional changes that can be carried out with one nurse.

Medstrom|bariatric tilt-in-space chair.description: The Medstrom Bariatric Tilt-in-Space chair provides a versatile seating and transport solution for high dependency plus-size patients. Multiple positions can be effortlessly achieved via an intuitive electrically operated handset, providing comfort for the patient and removing moving and handling risks for the caregiver.

Contact Us Custom Biliary – Biodegradable Stent Treatment of benign biliary stenosis can present significant challenges that many clinicians and interventional endoscopists can relate to. Off-the-shelf solutions often involve compromise, especially when patient-specific anatomy or pathology demands more precision. Key points: Benign biliary stenosis can be difficult to treat effectively with standard stent sizes and designs.
Clinicians often have to settle for the “closest fit”, which may not always yield optimal results.
Custom-made biodegradable stents, like those from Ella CS, offer a tailored approach that can better match the anatomy and healing profile of the patient.
Custom ERCP and CE marked Transhepatic options available.
Tracheal and bronchial stenting for complex benign airway disease can be extremely challenging, especially in newborns with congenital tracheal anomalies .
Postnatal complications , such as malformed or underdeveloped airways, often require creative and cutting-edge solutions.
Using a biodegradable stent avoids some of the long-term risks associated with traditional metallic or silicone stents.
The case at GOSH involved a scaffold-based approach , where the BD stent helped maintain airway structure while the stem-cell tissue matured and integrated.

Veni Vidi Medical Limited|pvp perforated.description: Polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) is an exclusive surface treatment applied to FCI lacrimal products to improve the hydrophilic properties of silicone. The benefit of such a treatment is to enhance the efficiency of tear drainage and to limit the accumulation of debris at the surface of our silicone intubations and PVP perforated plugs. FCI PVP perforated plugs are used to treat excessive tearing due to partial occlusion of punctum and punctal stenosis. They act as a conformer by keeping the punctal opening dilated for several weeks, allowing tears to be drained through. Details: PVP Perforated Plugs • Designed by J.-A. Bernard, M.D. • Slanted collarette for a perfect anatomical fit against the eyelid margin • Exclusive polishing for a perfectly smooth surface • Preloaded on a disposable plug inserter to facilitate the insertion • Option with PVP coating for superior tear drainage • 2 models available • Sterile, Single use * Th Malet, B Challier, N David, A Bertrand, J-L George “Clinical and scintigraphic comparison of silicone and polyvinylpyrrolidone coated silicone perforated plugs”. Br J Ophthalmol 1998;82:1416–1419. The PVP perforated plugs are Class IIb medical devices manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Veni Vidi Medical Limited|lacrijet.description: LacriJet LacriJet® is FCI latest and exclusive preloaded & self-retaining monocanalicular nasolacrimal intubation indicated for epiphora, congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction and canalicular laceration. It consists of a single use injector handpiece into which a silicone tube is preloaded inside a metallic guide. LacriJet® has been specifically designed to reduce operating time, eitherin the intubation phase as well as forthe removal of the device. LacriJet® is first introduced into the nasolacrimal duct. Once in position, the sliding piston is retracted and the silicone intubation is released. It is maintained in place at the punctum by a plug-like fixation head: no nasal retrieval, no knots and no sutures are needed. The smaller sizes LacriJet® 15 mm and 20 mm have been specifically designed for canalicular laceration repair to prevent future canalicular obstruction due to scar tissue formation. • Exclusive new injection system • Silicone tube preloaded inside the metallic guide • No nasal retrieval • No knots • No sutures • Available in 7 lengths • 3 mm plug collarette • Requires sizer(S1.1288)to select the length & 0.3 mm disposable punctum dilator and plug inserter(S1.3090) • Sterile, Single use The LacriJet® (Class IIb) is a medical device manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459

Veni Vidi Medical Limited|precivia® devi.description: The Disposable Precivia® Device Precivia Device is a tried and tested disposable device that simplifies* intravitreal injections. Its special design ensures a fast, accurate & predictable procedure*. • The Precivia Device eliminates unnecessary instruments: no speculum, caliper or pressure plate needed. • Assures accuracy: fixed guide ensures proper angle, depth & distance of injection every time. • Relaxes patients*: immobilizes the eye & hides the needle resulting in less patient anxiety. • Prevents leakage*: Rotating the device pre & post injection, displaces & replaces the conjunctiva over the injection hole. The Precivia Device is the gold standard for all intravitreal injections. Precivia Device Notes: An intravitreal injection is a shot of medicine into injected into the eye. The inside of the eye is filled with a jelly-like fluid (vitreous). During this procedure, a health care provider injects medicine into the vitreous, near the retina at the back of the eye. The medicine can treat certain eye problems and help protect your vision. This method is most often used to get a higher level of medicine to the retina. *References: Ratnarajan G, Nath R, Appaswamy S, et al. Intravitreal injections using a novel conjunctival mould: a comparison with a conventional technique. British Journal of Ophthalmology 2013;97:395-397. Petri, A., Boysen, K., Cehofski, L.J. et al. Intravitreal Injections with Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor Inhibitors: A Practical Approach. Ophthalmol Ther 9, 191–203 (2020). ¹Registered trade mark of Genentech Inc. ²Registred trade mark of Bayer AG. ¹*Please verify the medical use of Avastin® with your local authorities. Precivia® is a Class Is medical device indicated for intravitreal injections and manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Thanks to the rigid guides inside the silicone tube, the placement of the Autostable Bicanaliculus Intubation Set II is straighforward, and can be done as an office procedure. • Silicone wings at each end ensure the stability in the lacrimal sac • Central mark to control tube placement • Supplied with disposable dilator • Available in 3 lengths: 25, 30 and 35mm • Requires sizer (S1.1289) to select the appropriate length • Medical grade silicone • Sterile The Autostable Bicanaliculus Intubation Set II (Class IIb) is a medical devices manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

The metallic guides are located inside the lumen, not as an extension of the stent as in conventional intubation sets. Therefore, no nasal retrieval is needed. The stability is guaranteed by the design of the silicone tubes: no need to make knots and sutures in the nasal fossa. • Indicated for canalicular pathologies, congenital lacrimal duct obstruction & dacryocystorhinostomy (DCR) • No nasal retrieval • No knot or suture needed • Available in 2 lengths: 90 mm and 105 mm • Medical grade silicone • Sterile The FCI Nunchaku® is a Class IIbmedical device manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

It consists of a silicone tube connected at each extremity to a PEEK thread guide. It is designed to reduce operating time and trauma for the patients, either in the intubation phase as well as for the removal of the device. The intubation is self-retaining thanks to two wider silicone portions on the silicone tube. The surgical procedure is similar to the conventional Ritleng® lacrimal intubation and involves the use of Ritleng® instruments. • Regular 0.64mmsilicone tube for a comfortable fit in the intrapalpebral loop • Wider 0.94 mm silicone segments to be positioned in the lacrimal sac ensuring the self-retaining feature of the intubation: no need tomake knots in the nasal fossa • Blackmark to control the central placement and correct positioning of the silicone tube between the two punctums • Easy removal fromthe nose • Require Ritleng® instruments (S1.1460, S1.1470, S1.1480) The Ritleng®+ intubation systemis a Class IIbmedical devicemanufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

The procedure involves inserting the hollow Ritleng® Probe into the nasolacrimal duct and feeding the thin PEEK thread through it. The probe is then withdrawn, leaving the PEEK to pull the silicone tubing into place. • Less traumatic for patients • Easy retrieval from the nose • Medical grade silicone – PVP option • Sterile The Ritleng® lacrimal intubation set is a Class IIb medical device manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

SureScreen Diagnostics|chlamydia cassett.description: Rapid screening test for Chlamydia trachomatis infection. The Chlamydia trachomatis Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of Chlamydia trachomatis antigen in clinical specimens such as urine or swabs, depending on the test configuration. Chlamydia infection is often asymptomatic, making screening an essential part of sexual health programmes. This rapid test delivers results within minutes, supporting timely identification and referral for further clinical management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|psa rapid test ca.description: Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of prostate‑specific antigen levels. The PSA Rapid Test Cassette is a semi‑quantitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of prostate‑specific antigen (PSA) in whole blood, serum or plasma. Elevated PSA levels may be associated with prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia or prostatitis. This test provides rapid screening results to support early clinical assessment and monitoring in professional healthcare and urology settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|nitazene powder t.description: Rapid powder screening for synthetic nitazene opioids in harm reduction and forensic settings The Nitazene Powder Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device designed to screen dissolved powder samples for the presence of nitazenes. Nitazines are a group of potent synthetic opioids increasingly associated with fatal overdose incidents. Operating at a cut-off of 2000 ng/mL, the cassette delivers a visual result in 5 minutes from a prepared powder solution, without laboratory analysis. It is a valuable tool for drug checking services, harm reduction organisations, forensic drug testing teams and law enforcement agencies seeking to identify high-risk synthetic opioids in seized or submitted substances. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|gamma-hydroxybuty.description: Rapid urine test for GHB detection at 10 µg/mL for clinical and forensic use The gamma-hydroxybutyrate (GHB) Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device that detects GHB in urine at a cut-off of 10 µg/mL. GHB is a central nervous system depressant associated with recreational misuse and drug-facilitated sexual assault. Because GHB clears from the body rapidly, often within 4-8 hours of ingestion, fast testing is critical in clinical and forensic settings. The cassette format requires only 3 drops of urine and delivers a clear visual result in 5 minutes, making it practical for emergency departments, sexual assault referral centres (SARCs) and forensic drug testing programmes. For professional use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|cotinine cassette.description: Rapid urine testing for Nicotine and Tobacco exposure screening The Cotinine Cassette is a rapid immunoassay test that detects cotinine – the primary metabolite of nicotine – in urine. As the main breakdown product of nicotine from tobacco and e-cigarettes, cotinine provides a reliable biomarker for tobacco and nicotine product use. Results are available within minutes with no laboratory equipment required, making the test practical for smoking cessation programmes, occupational health checks and insurance or pre-employment screening. Available in two cut-off configurations to suit different screening requirements: COT100 (100 ng/mL) for sensitive detection of light exposure; COT200 (200 ng/mL) for standard smoking status screening. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|drugtrace surface.description: Rapid, portable surface drug test for detecting trace drug residues from powders or surfaces, with results in 5 minutes DrugTrace is a non-invasive, surface-based drug residue detection test that screens for 8 drug classes from swabbed surfaces or dissolved powder samples. No biological specimen is required from individuals. The 8 panel test simultaneously detects amphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, ketamine, MDMA, methamphetamine, opiates and cannabis from a single surface swab and buffer solution. Results are available in 5 minutes. DrugTrace is designed for prisons, probation services, workplaces, border control, law enforcement and any setting where surface contamination monitoring or non-invasive drug detection is required. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|hair drug confirm.description: Chain of Custody hair sample collection kit for confirmatory laboratory drug testing The Hair Drug Confirmation Kit is a complete professional collection kit for gathering, packaging and despatching hair samples to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Hair testing provides a significantly longer detection window than urine or oral fluid. A standard 3 cm head hair sample reflects approximately 0-3 months of drug use history, and extended history testing is possible with longer samples. The kit is used in workplace investigations, child safeguarding assessments, legal proceedings, insurance programmes and any situation where a robust, defensible, long-window drug use history is required. The kit includes all materials for a standardised, Chain of Custody compliant collection. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|covid-19 igg/igm.product: Covid-19 IgG/IgM Antibody Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|covid-19 igg/igm.description: Rapid screening of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2 in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. These antibodies may be present following previous exposure to the virus or as part of an immune response. IgM antibodies typically appear earlier in the immune response, while IgG antibodies may persist for a longer period. Combined IgG/IgM detection supports antibody screening and serological assessment when interpreted alongside clinical evaluation and patient history. The test delivers results within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used for the diagnosis of acute SARS‑CoV‑2 infection. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|alcohol rapid tes.description: Rapid saliva alcohol screening using a simple dip and read test strip. The Alcohol Rapid Test Strip is a simple, instrument‑free solution for the qualitative detection of alcohol in saliva. Based on enzymatic oxidation technology, the strip produces a colour change proportional to alcohol concentration, covering a range from 0.02% to 0.30%. Designed for professional use, it delivers fast, easy‑to‑interpret results within minutes, making it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol checks where immediate decision‑making is required. For professional use only . Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|adulteration stri.description: 7 parameter urine validity strips for detecting specimen tampering and substitution Adulteration Strips are rapid test strips that simultaneously assess 7 specimen validity parameters from a single urine dip, helping to identify samples that may have been tampered with, diluted or substituted. Parameters include pH, creatinine, nitrites, bleach, glutaraldehyde, PCC (pyridinium chlorochromate) and specific gravity. Detecting adulterated specimens is a critical quality control step in drug testing programmes, particularly in workplace and forensic settings where the integrity of results must be assured. Strips deliver clear colour-change results immediately after dipping, with no additional equipment required. For professional use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|temperature strip.description: Simple temperature verification for urine specimens This single-use temperature strip attaches to a urine specimen container and gives an immediate visual reading to confirm the sample is within the expected body temperature range of 32-39°C. Checking specimen temperature is a straightforward way to detect samples that may have been substituted or tampered with during collection. It is a standard part of many workplace and forensic drug testing protocols. For professional use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|drinkspike dip ca.description: On the spot screening for GHB, ketamine and benzodiazepines in drinks DrinkSpike is a rapid 3 panel dip card test that screens drinks for three substances most commonly associated with drink spiking: GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyrate), ketamine and benzodiazepines. The card is simply dipped into the suspect drink and results are read in 5 minutes. No specialist knowledge, equipment or laboratory is required. DrinkSpike is compact, discreet and designed for use in bars, clubs, universities, events and any setting where personal safety is a priority. It can be used on alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|urine drug confir.description: Chain of Custody urine drug confirmation kit for laboratory verified drug test results. The Urine Drug Confirmation Kit is a professional grade sample collection and packaging kit used to send urine specimens to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Designed to meet Chain of Custody requirements, it is suitable for workplace investigations, clinical settings, legal proceedings and forensic drug testing where a defensible, laboratory confirmed result is required. The kit contains all necessary components for secure, tamper-evident sample collection, sealing and despatch. Confirmatory analysis is performed using LC-MS/MS or equivalent technology at an approved laboratory. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|sureswab rapid.description: Fast, donor friendly oral fluid drug test for on-site, rehab and clinical screening. SureSwab Rapid is a streamlined oral fluid drug screening device designed for faster collection and quicker results than standard oral fluid tests. A click-activated swab mechanism ensures accurate sample insertion, while a red saturation indicator confirms sufficient saliva collection in as little as 30 seconds. Available in a 7 panel configuration covering amphetamine, benzodiazepines, cocaine, methamphetamine, ketamine, opiates and cannabis. SureSwab Rapid is CE-marked and suitable for workplace, occupational health and on-site drug testing where speed and ease of use are critical. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|on call® blood gl.product: On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System
SureScreen Diagnostics|on call® blood gl.description: Integrated blood glucose and ketone monitoring system for routine metabolic health management. The On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System supports routine monitoring of blood glucose and β‑ketone levels using compatible test strips and a dual‑function meter. Designed for wellness and metabolic health management, the system enables regular monitoring to support diabetes management and ketone awareness. Components are intended for in vitro diagnostic use with capillary whole blood samples and provide clear, digital results when used according to the relevant Instructions for Use. For self testing and professional use

SureScreen Diagnostics|c-reactive protei.description: Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of C‑reactive protein (CRP) to support the assessment of inflammation and infection risk. The CRP semi-quantitative rapid test cassette is designed to provide fast and accurate measurement of C-reactive protein, supporting infection and inflammation assessment in professional healthcare settings. The test cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of C‑reactive protein (CRP) in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. CRP is a non‑specific inflammatory marker that may be elevated in response to infection, tissue injury or inflammatory disease. The test delivers a semi-quantitative result by categorising CRP concentrations into clinically relevant ranges. This supports the assessment and monitoring of inflammatory conditions and may assist healthcare professionals in evaluating the likelihood of bacterial infection when interpreted alongside clinical findings and other diagnostic information. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for both point-of-care and laboratory environments. The test is designed for professional use and provides a rapid screening solution where timely inflammation assessment is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|pregnancy test mi.description: Convenient midstream urine test for rapid hCG detection. The Pregnancy Test Midstream is a rapid, one‑step lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine. The midstream format allows direct urine application without the need for additional collection devices, providing a convenient option for pregnancy screening in professional and supervised settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

SureScreen Diagnostics|hcg pregnancy rap.description: Dip‑and‑read urine pregnancy test strip for hCG detection. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Strip is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine specimens. The strip format offers a simple, cost‑effective solution for high‑volume pregnancy screening in professional settings. Results are available within minutes and are intended as a preliminary screening aid. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Rapid qualitative detection of hCG to support early pregnancy screening. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine, serum or plasma specimens. hCG is produced shortly after implantation and is an established marker for early pregnancy detection. This test provides clear results within minutes and supports use in professional clinical and laboratory settings as a screening aid for pregnancy. For professional in vitro use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|transferrin & fae.product: Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|transferrin & fae.description: Dual detection of occult blood and transferrin in stool samples. The Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative immunoassay designed to detect both human haemoglobin and transferrin in stool specimens. Combined testing improves the detection of gastrointestinal bleeding from both upper and lower regions of the GI tract. This enhanced screening approach supports early identification of conditions associated with colorectal and upper gastrointestinal cancers. For professional use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|group a streptoco.product: Group A Streptococcus pyogenes (Strep A) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|group a streptoco.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Group A Streptococcus infection. The Strep A Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Group A Streptococcus antigens from throat swab specimens. Producing results within minutes, it supports rapid assessment of streptococcal pharyngitis in clinical and primary care environments. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|influenza (flu) a.product: Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|influenza (flu) a.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Influenza A and Influenza B from a nasal swab. The Influenza A/B Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of Influenza A and Influenza B antigens from nasal swab specimens. Delivering clear results within minutes, it supports fast clinical decision‑making during respiratory infection assessment. The test is intended for professional use in point‑of‑care settings such as GP practices, clinics and healthcare environments where rapid differentiation of influenza types is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|covid-19 antigen.product: Covid-19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette – Gold
SureScreen Diagnostics|covid-19 antigen.description: Reliable, rapid screening for SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab samples. The COVID‑19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab specimens. Antigen testing supports the screening of individuals with suspected acute infection and aids infection control decision‑making when used alongside clinical assessment. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The test is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used as the sole basis for diagnosis or patient management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|faecal occult blo.product: Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|faecal occult blo.description: Rapid stool test for the qualitative detection of faecal occult blood. The Faecal Occult Blood (FOB) Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of human haemoglobin in faecal specimens. The presence of occult blood in stool may indicate gastrointestinal bleeding associated with conditions such as colorectal cancer, polyps or ulcers. The test delivers fast results at the point of care and does not require dietary restrictions, making it suitable for routine screening and early clinical assessment in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|helicobacter pylo.product: Helicobacter Pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|helicobacter pylo.description: Rapid stool antigen screening for active Helicobacter pylori infection. The H. pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Helicobacter pylori antigens in stool specimens, supporting diagnosis of gastrointestinal infection associated with ulcers and gastritis. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|respiratory syncy.product: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|respiratory syncy.description: Rapid point‑of‑care RSV antigen detection from nasal swab specimens. The RSV Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of Respiratory Syncytial Virus antigens from nasal swab specimens. RSV is a common cause of respiratory infection, particularly in infants, young children and older adults. This test delivers clear results within minutes, supporting timely clinical assessment and infection management in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|etg urine alcohol.description: Urine alcohol screening using ETG for extended detection after drinking. The ETG Urine Alcohol Test is a rapid screening test designed to detect ethyl glucuronide (EtG), a direct metabolite of alcohol, in urine at a cut‑off of 1000 ng/mL. Unlike saliva or breath tests that indicate recent alcohol use, ETG testing extends the detection window, identifying alcohol consumption for up to several days after drinking. The test is suited to professional screening programmes where alcohol abstinence or compliance monitoring is required, including workplace testing, occupational health and rehabilitation settings. Results are available within minutes using a simple dip and read format. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|sars-cov-2 & infl.product: SARS-CoV-2 & Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette
SureScreen Diagnostics|sars-cov-2 & infl.description: Combined antigen screening for Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B from one sample. The first dual test in the UK to be awarded CTDA approval. The SARS‑CoV‑2 & Influenza A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B antigens from a single nasal swab. This combined approach supports efficient differential diagnosis of respiratory infections at the point of care, delivering fast results to aid clinical decision‑making. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|intoximeter.description: Advanced breath alcohol screening with optional printed results. The Intoximeter is a professional breath alcohol screening device designed for organisations requiring enhanced functionality and robust testing workflows. Using fuel cell sensor technology, it delivers fast and consistent BrAC screening results from breath samples. In addition to direct breath testing, the Intoximeter supports passive and drink sniffer modes, allowing screening without a direct mouthpiece blow. Optional integrated printing provides immediate hard‑copy records, making the device suitable for structured workplace, clinical and compliance‑driven alcohol screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|alcometer.description: Reliable breath alcohol screening using fuel cell sensor technology. The Alcometer is a professional breath alcohol tester designed to provide fast, reliable screening for alcohol using advanced fuel cell sensor technology. Measuring breath alcohol concentration (BrAC) across a range of 0.00 to 2.00 mg/L, it delivers clear digital results within seconds. Its compact, easy‑to‑use design makes it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol testing where quick, preliminary results are required. Built‑in warning indicators support alcohol policy thresholds while maintaining straightforward operation for professional users. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|urinalysis reagen.description: Dip‑and‑read urine reagent strips for rapid multiparameter screening. Urinalysis Reagent Strips are dip‑and‑read test strips designed for the rapid qualitative and semi‑quantitative detection of multiple parameters in urine, including glucose, protein, blood, ketones, pH, nitrite and leukocytes. Results provide valuable information relating to general metabolic status, kidney and urinary tract function, and overall health. These strips are intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use and can be read visually using a colour chart or instrumentally with urine chemistry analysers. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|sureswab.description: Non-invasive oral fluid multi-drug test for workplace and rehabilitation screening. SureSwab is an oral fluid (saliva) drug screening device that detects multiple drugs of abuse without the need for urine collection or restroom facilities. Using a sponge collector, the donor provides a saliva sample which is transferred to the integrated test cassette. A collection indicator confirms that sufficient sample has been obtained. Available in 8 and 10 panel configurations, SureSwab is CE marked and designed for use in workplace drug testing, ‘for cause’ testing, rehabilitation programmes and any setting where observed, non-invasive collection is important. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|multi-cassette.description: Flexible multi‑drug urine screening from a single low‑volume sample. The Multi‑cassette urine drug test offers flexible multi‑drug screening using individual cassettes from a single urine specimen. Designed for low sample volumes, it allows specific drug combinations to be tested simultaneously with results available in minutes. Its modular format is well suited to workplaces, laboratories and clinical settings requiring adaptable screening options. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|single drug test.description: Targeted, cost‑effective urine drug screening with fast, reliable results. The Single Drug Test Strip provides a simple and cost effective solution for targeted urine drug screening where only one analyte is required. Designed for professional use, it delivers clear visual results in minutes without the need for laboratory equipment. Its compact format makes it ideal for high volume testing programmes, workplace screening and clinical settings requiring focused testing for specific drugs. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|multi-panel.description: High throughput dip‑and‑read urine drug screening in a single device. The Multi‑panel urine drug test houses multiple test strips in one dip‑and‑read device, enabling simultaneous screening for several drug classes. Designed for high throughput environments, it delivers results in minutes while reducing handling and simplifying workflow. Its robust construction and clear visual cues support consistent use in workplace and clinical screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

SureScreen Diagnostics|rapid cup.description: Fast, secure urine drug screening with integrated testing strips. The Rapid Cup is an all in one urine drug test cup designed for fast on‑site screening. Integrated test strips and built in validity indicators streamline the collection to result process, reducing handling and delivering results within minutes. Its secure, leak resistant design makes it ideal for workplace, clinical and mobile testing environments. For professional use only

SureScreen Diagnostics|integrated key cu.description: All in one urine drug test cup with enhanced specimen security and rapid results. The Integrated Key Cup combines urine collection and multi‑drug screening in a single secure device. A built‑in activation key controls test initiation, reducing handling and supporting sample integrity. With clear results available in minutes and integrated validity checks, it is widely used in workplace, occupational health and forensic screening programmes where security, speed and ease of use are essential. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Serchem Limited|dfm 25.description: Regulated Disinfectant Cleaner. PT2 Disinfectant – BPR Registered. pH neutral. Achieves full disinfection in just 1 minute. Eliminates the pre-cleaning step entirely, reducing time, chemical usage, and the risk of cross-contamination between cleaning and disinfection stages. Designed to deliver excellent surface aesthetics on a range of surfaces. Benefitting from properties such as: Low residue, low tackiness, low streaking (high gloss and low haze), compatible with alcohol-sensitive surfaces. Safe on a wide range of materials including plastics, rubber, glass, and metal alloys, without the surface damage risks associated with acidic or alkaline disinfectants. Should not be used on Brass, Copper and Mild Steel.

MatOrtho Ltd|principles of the saiph med.description: Principles of the 'SAIPH ® Medially Stabilised' Knee Information for healthcare professionals Tibiofemoral Articulation The SAIPH® Knee design is based on the principle of medial stability in the normal knee, which has been described in historical literature 2 and widely in recent literature 3,4,5 . In normal, healthy knees the shapes of the medial and lateral tibial condyles are different: the medial side is concave; the lateral side is convex. Stability is provided collectively by the collateral ligaments (MCL and LCL), both cruciate ligaments (ACL and PCL) and the menisci. The shapes of the articular surfaces and the arrangement of stabilising soft tissue structures collectively provide greater stability about the medial condyle. Knee flexion is accompanied by axial rotation of the femur with respect to the tibia, which is achieved with a limited freedom for antero-posterior (AP) movement of the lateral femoral condyle relative to the tibia. Stability throughout flexion is crucial to normal knee function: a knee with a deficient ACL or medial meniscus, for example, is likely to be unstable and may require corrective surgery. MatOrtho Ltd|development of modern day h.description: Development of Modern-Day Hip Resurfacing Information for healthcare professionals Modern-day hip resurfacing is based on observations of patients with large diameter metal-on-metal (MoM) total hip prostheses such as the McKee-Farrar and the Ring Hip (Figure 1), who retained functioning hips with very little wear for more than 30 years after their operation 3 . Finsbury (now MatOrtho ® ) was involved in the development of the Birmingham Hip Resurfacing (BHR), which was based on study of the successful devices and the application of modern manufacturing techniques. Since its first use in 1997, thousands of successful hip resurfacing procedures have been performed around the world. Figure 1: Historical MoM prosthesis: the Ring Hip implanted 1964–1979. The ADEPT ® Hip Resurfacing System was developed using the knowledge gained by direct involvement in the BHR and the extensive research of historical MoM devices, and as the original manufacturer of the BHR 3 , manufacturing over 200,000 BHR devices. MatOrtho Ltd|clinical heritage success o.description: Clinical Heritage: Success of the MRK™ Information for healthcare professionals Clinical Heritage: Success of the MRK™ The MRK™, also manufactured by MatOrtho® (previously Finsbury), is the original 1994 ‘medial ball-and-socket knee’ and remains in popular use. The clinical success of the MRK™ has strong relevance as a ‘proof of concept’ to the expected long-term outcomes for the SAIPH® Knee, which is an evolution of the original design. Overall, the MRK™ has been shown to provide greater inherent stability than comparator devices 18,19,20 . Patients with a medially stabilised knee notice the difference, and express that they prefer the design over posterior substituting (PS), cruciate retaining (CR) and mobile designs, citing feelings of stability, normality and strength on stairs as reasons for their preference 21,22 . With its lateralised trochlea 11 the MRK™ exhibits a more normal patellar function 12 . It provides better restoration of ROM when compared to a standard PS knee design 23 and mean ROM is equal that of a ‘high-flex’ knee 24 . When compared to all other TKR designs, NJR collected patient reported outcome measures (PROMs) show that the benefits of the MRK™ are reflec

MatOrtho Ltd|orthopaedic data evaluation.description: Orthopaedic Data Evaluation Panel (ODEP) Information for healthcare professionals ODEP provide a service evaluation for TKR ratings and award ratings based on ongoing assessment of implant performance (rate of revision), and the number of patients for which principally UK data is available. The registries and clinical studies described in this document report excellent rates of survivorship for the SAIPH® Knee, with cumulative revision rates lower than the average TKR revision rates and among the lowest of all available devices 17,43,45 . Within the MatOrtho® philosophy for safe introduction of new technology, the SAIPH® Knee was released with limited availability and under closely monitored use over the first 10 years. To ensure versions of implant brands are reported appropriately, ODEP separate devices into their available constructs. For the SAIPH® Knee, this means separating UK data for SAIPH® Knee procedures with no patella, with a cementless patella and with a cemented patella. Consequently, cohorts on which ODEP ratings are based for each construct remain small. The SAIPH® Knee is most commonly used in the UK without a patella resurfacing and so a longer rating is available

Some have also produced cementless component versions. Higher revision rates 17,43 , particularly tibial loosening 44 have been associated with these combined design characteristics. The MRK™ and SAIPH ® Knees include a different fixation design to traditional keel designs, which is intended to support rotational torque at the implant-bone interface. The first clinical follow up on MRK™ patients who had received the implant from 1994 commented specifically on the matter and showed that the increased congruence of the asymmetric tibial bearing had not increased the rate of loosening 15 . From 15,921 procedures recorded by the NJR over 18.5 years, the MRK™ has been revised for aseptic loosening of the tibia significantly fewer times (p<0.001) than all other TKRs in the UK 16 . MatOrtho Ltd|clinical function of the sa.description: Clinical Function of the SAIPH ® Knee Information for healthcare professionals Normal Pattern of Movement (Knee Kinematics) Balancing stability with freedom of movement is a principal goal of TKR design. How well a TKR achieves this can be determined by evaluating the pattern of movement in patients’ knees during well-selected activities. To evaluate the kinematics of the SAIPH® Knee, a consecutive series of one surgeon’s first 14 patients (mean 69 years old, range 51-83), with no exclusions were assessed using video fluoroscopy at a minimum 24 months postoperatively 7 . Study participants were asked to perform clinically relevant functional activities, including: a full internal-to-external pivot standing on the affected leg to show the AP extents of medial and lateral condyles with large torque while under load; a kneeling activity to establish full passive flexion; lunge and step-up/down activities to establish ROM and AP stability in both condyles for the loaded knee. In all activities the SAIPH® Knee exhibited an asymmetric pattern of movement: the knee was AP stable on the medial side and lateral translation was permitted when required (Figure 1) 7 . Love Medical|motion sprint 900 pl.description: The motion sprint 900 PL is the result of decades of development and close collaboration between leading research institutions and elite sports organisations. This high-performance treadmill is designed to meet the rigorous demands of professional users, delivering a platform where clinical accuracy meets the intensity of competitive sports diagnostics. High-Torque Performance and Cushioned Stability Equipped with a powerful motor system, the motion sprint 900 PL ensures exceptional synchronisation and highly precise, reproducible speed regulation. Unlike the lamella models, the PL utilises a high-quality nubbed tread belt, specifically engineered to provide superior cushioning and joint protection during high-intensity sessions. This ensures that even at peak performance, the impact on the patient’s or athlete’s musculoskeletal system is minimised. Bespoke Customisation for Specialised Care The motion sprint 900 PL is uniquely versatile, offering a vast array of specialised accessories to suit diverse clinical and athletic needs. From reinforced handrails and forearm supports to safety brackets for fall protection, the system can be tailored to provide a secure environment for any user. Additionally, the option for running direction reversal and integrated communication interfaces makes this treadmill a professional-grade tool for highly specialised diagnostic applications.

Love Medical|motion sprint 900 se.description: Here is the edited copy for the motion sprint 900 SE, maintaining the professional and clinical tone consistent with your treadmill range while clearly distinguishing its specific feature set. The motion sprint 900 SE: Professional Slat-Technology for Level-Ground Training The motion sprint 900 SE is a robust, professional-grade treadmill featuring advanced lamella (slat) technology. Engineered for clinics and training facilities that require a high-performance, flat-surface running environment, the SE model provides the same exceptional joint protection and mechanical precision as the rest of the 900 series. Superior Impact Absorption and Mechanical Efficiency The running surface is composed of 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the lamellas to react dynamically to every step, creating a “swing” effect that significantly reduces impact forces on the patient’s joints. The low-friction design of the slat system ensures remarkably smooth synchronisation and allows for consistent operation at ultra-low speeds starting from just 0.1 km/h—ideal for early-stage gait training and neurological rehabilitation. While this specific model is designed for level-ground exercise (no inclination), it offers a standard speed range up to 17.0 km/h, with an optional performance package available to reach 22 km/h.

Love Medical|motion sprint 900 sl.description: The motion sprint 900 SL is a robust, high-performance treadmill engineered with advanced lamella (slat) technology. Designed for both clinical rehabilitation and professional athletic training, it provides a superior running surface that prioritises joint protection and mechanical precision. Advanced Lamella Engineering for Joint Protection At the heart of the motion sprint 900 SL are 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the running surface to “swing” freely and respond dynamically to every footfall. The result is a highly shock-absorbent surface that optimally protects the patient’s joints while ensuring smooth synchronisation even at low motor power. This low-friction design is particularly beneficial for delicate rehabilitation, as it enables smooth, consistent operation at speeds as low as 0.1 km/h. For higher-intensity diagnostics, the system supports speeds up to 17.0 km/h as standard, with an optional performance package increasing the maximum speed to 22 km/h.

Love Medical|motion stair 900.description: The motion stair 900 is the final component in our comprehensive equipment line, specifically designed to bridge the gap between clinical exercise therapy and functional everyday movement. By simulating the natural action of climbing stairs, it provides a highly effective platform for simultaneous cardiovascular conditioning, muscular strengthening, and the advancement of coordinative skills. Versatile Motion and Enhanced Patient Safety Unlike traditional steppers, the motion stair 900 utilises a pedal-independent system. This allows for a vast variety of movement amplitudes and specialised work tasks, making it an essential tool for training balance and motor coordination. To ensure the system is accessible to the widest possible patient demographic, the frame features a newly designed handrail. This ergonomic support provides a higher degree of security, extending the device’s application to users with compromised balance or weaker coordination. Furthermore, the entry point has been optimised for safer and easier access, ensuring patient confidence from the very start of the session.

Love Medical|motion body 900 wm.description: The motion body 900 WM provides the full therapeutic power of our premier upper-body trainer in a specialised, wall-mounted configuration. Designed for facilities where space is at a premium, this model maintains all the advanced functionality of the standard motion body 900 while offering a significantly smaller footprint and unhindered access for wheelchair users. Maximum Functionality, Minimal Footprint The motion body 900 WM is the ideal solution for clinics that require a high degree of flexibility without occupying valuable floor space. With a simple, robust installation on any solid wall, the unit becomes a permanent, stable fixture for a wide range of patients. Its impressive 40 cm vertical adjustment range allows clinicians to quickly set the drive axle to the perfect height for seated patients, wheelchair users, or those performing standing exercises. Like its floor-mounted counterpart, it features the ability to switch between asynchronous and synchronous “handibike” modes, ensuring it can handle everything from delicate joint mobilisation to intensive muscle-building protocols.

Love Medical|motion body 900.description: The motion body 900 is an indispensable component of holistic exercise therapy and integrated cardiovascular training. Specifically designed for active engagement of the upper extremities, this versatile system is ideal for both endurance training and the targeted mobilisation of the arms and shoulders following joint injuries or surgery. Exceptional Versatility and Ergonomics The drive unit features an extensive adjustment range, allowing the axle height to be perfectly positioned for both seated and standing training. The system supports both forward and backward movement, and the standard length-adjustable cranks can be quickly switched to a synchronous “handibike mode.” The asynchronous movement is excellent for shoulder joint and rotator cuff mobilisation, while the synchronous motion sequence is preferred for muscle building and is the optimal training mode for wheelchair users. To ensure maximum safety and comfort, the unit is equipped with Leki® grips. These feature a specialised click mechanism that allows for the use of hand straps or gloves, providing extra security for patients with limited grip strength.

Love Medical|motion cross 900.description: The motion cross 900 is designed to engage the entire body, making it an ideal solution for activating patients with sedentary lifestyles or those requiring low-impact cardiovascular conditioning. Its guided movement pattern ensures a safe and immediate start to training, promoting an upright posture while coordinating upper and lower body movement for maximum therapeutic benefit. Ergonomic Motion and Clinical Safety The system features long cranks and an ergonomic linkage between arm and leg movements, creating a smooth, sweeping stride that mimics natural motion. Unlike many other cross-trainers on the market, the motion cross 900 is engineered for joint-friendly performance and whisper-quiet operation. With its intuitive interface and easy-to-learn movement, the device allows patients to train effectively with minimal supervision, optimising staff resources. Furthermore, the exceptionally low step-on height of just 18 cm makes it one of the most accessible machines in its class for clinical rehabilitation.

Love Medical|motion relax 900.description: The motion relax 900 is a premium recumbent training system engineered for comfort during extended sessions. It is specifically designed to meet the needs of patients with neurological or orthopedic restrictions, as well as those requiring a higher weight capacity. By prioritising ergonomic support, the motion relax 900 ensures that even the most challenging rehabilitation goals remain accessible and safe. Enhanced Accessibility and Specialised Support This latest development features an extended step-through area and a narrow, joint-friendly Q-factor to promote natural movement. To ensure the safety of every patient, the unit is equipped with robust support handles for easy mounting and dismounting, alongside a standard adjustable backrest for personalised lumbar support. For bariatric care, the “Boosted 250” version offers an expanded swivel seat and high-positioned armrests, facilitating easier access and supporting a maximum user weight of 250 kg.

Love Medical|motion cycle 900.description: The motion cycle 900 has been meticulously engineered with a focus on biomechanical excellence, meeting the rigorous requirements for both clinical rehabilitation and athletic performance. Designed to provide an optimal, individualized training position, it ensures that every user—regardless of physical stature or mobility—can train safely and effectively. Maximum Accessibility and Ergonomic Flexibility Recognizing the needs of patients with restricted mobility, the motion cycle 900 features a compact housing that allows for a wide, low step-through of approximately 36–41 cm. This deep-axle design ensures effortless mounting and dismounting. The system is highly inclusive, accommodating a vast range of users from children (starting at 135 cm) to tall adults (up to 205 cm). With a narrow Q-factor of no more than 18 cm and a wide range of horizontal and vertical adjustments, the motion cycle 900 provides a natural, joint-friendly pedaling motion tailored to the individual.

Love Medical|motion 100 med.description: The motion cycle 100 med is a robust and medically certified ergometer that is easy to operate and includes the basic functions of a medical training device. It is always manufactured according to the medical directive (EU) 2017/745, class IIa and equipped with a coded pulse receiver, three training programmes, backlight and interface. The included quickstart programme is speed-dependent, the timed training is watt-constant and thus speed-independent. We also consider a pulse-controlled and therefore also speed-independent training programme to be essential for good endurance training. The valuable independence from the power grid avoids annoying tripping hazards and saves electricity. The unit is always equipped with a chip card reader so that training programmes can be stored on customer cards without a PC. The particularly small housing leaves enough space for easy access.

Love Medical|blueflow flow sensor.description: The Blueflow Flow Sensor is a revolutionary advancement in spirometry technology, specifically engineered for Geratherm Respiratory systems. Designed to meet the most stringent international criteria for pulmonary testing, the Blueflow sensor combines the high-precision performance of a gold-standard diagnostic tool with the convenience and safety of a fully disposable product. By utilising a pre-calibrated design, the Blueflow sensor ensures that every test delivers first-class results while providing complete security against cross-contamination, making it an essential component for any modern respiratory laboratory.

Love Medical|spirostik blueflow usb- pc.product: Spirostik BlueFlow USB- PC Spirometry System
Love Medical|spirostik blueflow usb- pc.description: The Spirostik Blue represents the latest advancement in spirometry from Geratherm Respiratory. A powerful and versatile diagnostic tool, it is designed for use across all clinical environments, from busy hospitals to private practices. Whether used for initial diagnosis, follow-up screening, or severity assessment, the Spirostik Blue is essential for the differential diagnosis of obstructive conditions—such as Asthma, COPD, and Emphysema—as well as restrictive diseases, including pulmonary fibrosis and neuromuscular disorders. Clinical Flexibility and Safety The Spirostik Blue is engineered for the modern clinic. It can function as a standalone device or be networked across multiple practices to centralise patient data. At its core is a pre-calibrated, single-use flow sensor designed with extremely low dead space, significantly improving patient safety and comfort. With its revolutionary snap-in handle, changing sensors is quick, easy, and secure, ensuring your clinic maintains the highest standards of hygiene and efficiency.

Love Medical|ambistik cpet.description: The Ambistik CPET builds upon the foundation of the standard Ambistik module, providing a specialised solution for the rigorous demands of Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing. In addition to monitoring temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity, this advanced module features integrated, continuous measurement of ambient CO2 levels. Precision Performance in High-Activity Environments In a clinical or sports science environment, ambient CO2 levels are rarely static. Factors such as multiple people in a testing room or the high ventilatory output of an athlete during maximal exertion can significantly elevate local CO2 concentrations. By feeding real-time CO2 data directly into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, the Ambistik CPET compensates for these fluctuations instantly. This ensures that gas exchange calculations remain undisputed, protecting the clinician from data misinterpretation and ensuring the highest level of accuracy for every CPET measurement.

Love Medical|smart pft nebuliser.description: Here is the edited copy for your Bronchial Challenge System, maintaining the professional, high-precision, and clinical tone established for your pulmonary diagnostic range. Featuring a medically certified, integrated air compressor, the system operates independently of any external air source, making it a versatile and self-contained solution for modern pulmonary laboratories. Automated Workflow and Clinical Compliance The system is engineered to fulfil all international standards for automated pulmonary testing routines. An integrated LCD screen provides the clinician with real-time information and guides the user through predefined test sequences, ensuring high reproducibility and a streamlined workflow. The low-noise operation of the built-in compressor ensures a calm environment, helping to keep the patient relaxed throughout the provocation protocol. Superior Hygiene and Environmental Protection Patient safety and hygiene are at the forefront of this system’s design. It utilises an advanced 3-way valve system that directs patient airflow precisely, preventing the exhaled air from contaminating the side stream nebuliser and the provocation liquid. Additionally, the system features integrated filtration for exhaled air, protecting the clinical environment and ensuring that both the patient and staff can breathe safely without risk of cross-contamination.

Love Medical|cardiopart 12 wlan- ecgpro.description: The AMEDTEC Mobile ECG is a high-performance 12-lead resting system designed for the rigours of modern clinical environments. Love Medical|spirostik blue– bluetooth s.description: The Spirostik Blue is the latest advancement in spirometry technology from Geratherm Respiratory, providing a powerful diagnostic tool suitable for everything from large hospitals to private clinics. It is a versatile solution for the initial diagnosis, follow-up screening, and severity assessment of a wide range of respiratory diseases. The system is essential for the differential diagnosis of obstructive conditions—such as Asthma, COPD, and Emphysema—as well as restrictive diseases, including Interstitial Lung Disease, pulmonary fibrosis, and neuromuscular disorders. Enhanced Safety and Versatility Designed with modern clinical needs in mind, the Spirostik Blue offers unparalleled flexibility. It can be used as a standalone spirometer or networked across multiple locations to centralise patient results from a group of practices. To ensure the highest standards of hygiene, the system utilises pre-calibrated, single-use flow sensors with extremely low dead space, significantly improving patient safety while eliminating the need for manual calibration.

Love Medical|ambistik.description: The Ambistik is a high-precision, USB-based module designed to monitor environmental conditions temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity with total accuracy. This data is continuously fed into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, enabling the system to perform real-time BTPS (Body Temperature, Pressure, and Saturated) corrections. Why Environmental Accuracy Matters In pulmonary function testing, precision is paramount. Lung function is measured at a constant body temperature of 37°C. As exhaled air cools, its volume decreases; even a small temperature variance of 2°C can result in a 1% deviation in measured results. Furthermore, atmospheric pressure—which fluctuates significantly between sea level and high altitudes—and humidity levels directly impact gas volume and oxygen concentration. Without accurate, real-time correction for these variables, diagnostic data can be compromised. The Ambistik eliminates this risk by providing a continuous stream of ambient data, ensuring every measurement is standardised and clinically valid.

Love Medical|2 safety pack.description: This excellent package offers all the protection of the Pulmosafe filter together with the comfort and infection control benefits of the Softclip noseclip packaged with a comfortable oval shaped mouthpiece adapter in one convenient single use pack, that represents a great cost benefit over the single items.

The couch features an exceptionally low entry height, allowing elderly or mobility-impaired patients to mount the device conveniently without interference from the ergometry unit or seat. Its robust, heavy-duty construction supports patient weights of up to 200 kg, ensuring a vibration-free environment during testing—a critical factor for acquiring high-quality ultrasound images during peak exertion.

Love Medical|ergoselect 10.description: The Ergoselect 10 is a multifunctional, half-reclining ergometer designed to provide maximum safety and stability during stress testing. It is an ideal solution for elderly patients or those with physical limitations, offering a secure alternative to upright exercise. Love Medical|minipulse mp1r.description: The MiniPulse Advanced range is the professional’s choice for clinicians requiring high-precision oxygen saturation and heart rate data in a portable format. Intus Healthcare|sleepnet arie nasal cpa.product: Sleepnet Arie Nasal CPAP Mask – FitPack
Intus Healthcare|sleepnet arie nasal cpa.description: Arie CPAP Nasal Mask The Arie Nasal Mask is designed to sit comfortably on the face without feeling bulky, helping reduce pressure points while maintaining a stable fit throughout the night. The lightweight design allows for flexibility and a clear field of vision, making this a good CPAP mask for side sleepers and active sleepers. Due to the AIR°sil Cushion which adapts to the contours of your face, this mask is easy to use as it ensures minimal air leaks and sits comfortably on your face. Check out the Quick Start Guide in the Downloads tab for extra guidance. Features of the Arie Nasal CPAP Mask AIR°sil Cushion Technology: Built with Sleepnet’s soft medical-grade silicone cushion, AIR°sil technology adapts to your facial contours to create a secure, comfortable seal while helping to minimise air leaks and skin irritation. 360° Rotating Swivel: A fully rotating swivel connection allows the tubing to move freely with you, reducing drag and helping maintain a consistent seal. This makes the Arie Nasal Mask a good option for active sleepers who may change sleeping positions during the night. Clear Field of Vision: The low-profile frame offers an open line of sight, making it easier to read, watch TV, or wear glasses before sleep without removing your mask. Lightweight Frame: The frame is made from lightweight materials to reduce any unnecessary bulk, designed to provide support and structure and sit comfortably on the head. Replaceable Parts: The cushion can be easily removed and replaced, helping maintain hygiene, easy cleaning and ensuring consistent performance over time. Who Is This Mask Suitable For? Nasal breathers Users who prefer a lightweight, minimal-contact mask Active or side sleepers Please note that this mask is not suitable for CPAP users that breathe through their mouth at night, and should consider the Arie Full Face Mask instead.
features: Users who prefer a lightweight, minimal-contact mask

Intus Healthcare|sleepnet arie full face.product: Sleepnet Arie Full Face CPAP Mask – FitPack
Intus Healthcare|sleepnet arie full face.description: Arie Full Face CPAP Mask The Sleepnet Arie Full Face CPAP Mask covers both the nose and mouth, making it suitable for mouth breathers or those with nasal congestion. Alongside the compact and lightweight frame, this mask reduces any unnecessary bulk. The cushion is produced with medical-grade silicone, and Sleepnet’s innovative AIR°sil cushion technology gently adapts to the contours of each face to create a soft, secure seal that minimizes air leaks. Check out the Quick Start guide in the Downloads tab for extra guidance on getting started with this mask. Features of the Arie CPAP Full Face Mask Soft AIR°sil Cushion for Comfort and Fit: The silicone cushion adapts to facial contours to create a comfortable seal while helping to reduce air leaks. Lightweight, Low-Profile Frame: Designed to reduce bulk while maintaining stability, helping improve comfort throughout the night. 360° Swivel for Freedom of Movement: The rotating swivel allows the tubing to move naturally, helping maintain a consistent seal in different sleeping positions. Clear Line of Sight: The design keeps your vision unobstructed, so you can relax before sleep without removing the mask. Easy Maintenance: The removable cushion allows for easy cleaning and replacement, helping to keep your therapy hygienic. Who Is This Mask Suitable For? Mouth breathers Users with nasal congestion Those needing a dependable seal at higher pressures

DDC Dolphin Limited|water trap.description: UVMATIC® Water Trap Effective reduction of bacteria in sinks and wash basins. Water traps are some of the most contaminated areas in hospitals and increasingly recognised as potential vehicles for transmission of multi-drug resistant bacteria to patients. Water used for staff hand washing, hygiene of patients or washing devices is contaminated and then drained through the sinks. If the flow of the water is restricted, biofilm-forming bacteria may form stable reservoirs in the waste pipes and the semi-horizontal drain pipes if they are not inclined enough or are partially blocked. The UVMATIC® Water Trap Disinfector keeps the water in sink waste pipes sanitised, killing bacteria and preventing biofilm formulation. By preventing the spread of multi-resistant bacteria you reduce the risk of HCAI’s which is not only cost efficient, but also safeguards your clinicians and patients’ health. The UVC lamp only uses approximately 12w per hour and will only need changing once a year for continued efficiency. Coolmed|cmrtsg500 solid door rts cabinet.description: This large-sized glass door refrigerator has a net capacity of 500L and provides plenty of storage space in a compact cabinet. It defrosts automatically and is fitted with a 2m plug for ease of installation. The temperature range is from 15-25°C and is stabilised by our high quality temperature sensor, which keeps the internal temperature even and stable. The fridge records minimum and maximum temperatures when plugged into the power source, but will continue to operate if this fails by running on the batteries installed in the panel on the side of the cabinet. The interior of the cabinet is painted aluminium and there are plastic-coated wire shelves for ease of cleaning. The LED display controller can be easily set to your required temperature. A bright LED strip lamp gives clear illumination to the interior. If the temperature drops below or raises above the set level, an audible alarm will sound. Similarly, the alarm will sound if the door is accidentally left open or not shut properly. The refrigerator has adjustable feet to ensure stability and the door is lockable, with 2 keys provided. 2 year warranty.

Chunc Limited|suction box holder.description: Suction Box Holder Engineered for stability and durability. The holder integrates neatly with the wheelchair frame while minimising obstruction to manoeuvrability and occupant comfort. Its robust construction helps protect equipment during movement, while the open-access design allows for quick removal and operation of the suction unit when required. Suitable for use in clinical, community, and home-care environments, the Suction Box Holder forms part of a wider range of medical equipment support accessories developed to improve safety, organisation, and ease of care for wheelchair users requiring ongoing medical support without compromising overall wheelchair function. Designed To Support: Portable suction equipment during daily mobility Complex respiratory and airway management needs Community, home-care, and clinical environments Safe, practical integration alongside other medical accessories
features: Portable suction equipment during daily mobility
