Chunc Limited|footbox.description: Footbox Chunc footboxes are designed to support safe, consistent foot positioning within a wheelchair seating system. By maintaining correct foot alignment, they help reduce strain on joints and muscles while supporting a neutral pelvic position — a key foundation for stable and effective seated posture. A footbox is particularly beneficial for users with increased muscle tone, involuntary movements, contractures, or reduced sensation in the lower limbs. By enclosing the feet, it helps prevent them from slipping off the footplates, protects against accidental impacts or friction, and assists in managing uncontrolled leg or foot movements. This added containment supports improved lower limb stability and overall postural control. Optional padding can be added to enhance comfort and pressure management. Padded footboxes help distribute pressure more evenly, reduce muscle fatigue by minimising the effort required to maintain positioning, and lower the risk of pressure-related skin concerns during prolonged use. Footboxes are often considered for users who spend long periods in their wheelchair, have a higher risk of pressure injury, experience spasms or high muscle tone, or require additional postural support for development. They can also provide reassurance for caregivers by helping maintain consistent and protected foot positioning throughout daily activities. Flip-up footbox options are available for users who require greater flexibility. These designs allow easier access for transfers, support foot positioning prior to standing, and enable leg position adjustments throughout the day. This makes them particularly helpful when caregiver access and functional movement are important considerations.

Chunc Limited|sunshade and raincover.description: Sunshade and Raincover Designed specifically for Chunc wheelchairs, the sunshade and raincover offers versatile protection for children and adults in any weather. Whether shielding from harsh sunlight or keeping dry in rain, this accessory ensures comfort, safety, and continued participation in outdoor activities. The lightweight, durable design is easy to attach and remove, and its adjustable frame allows a secure fit for different wheelchair models. Transparent panels maintain visibility, while side and rear coverage help protect from wind and rain. Perfect for parents and caregivers, the Chunc sunshade and rain cover enhances user comfort during outdoor activities, excursions, and daily travel. Its practical, easy to use design makes it an essential functional accessory for Chunc wheelchair users.

Chunc Limited|under chassis equipment tr.description: Under Chassis Equipment Tray For wheelchair users with complex medical and mobility needs, essential life-support equipment must remain safely secured, easily accessible, and stable throughout the day. Under-chassis equipment trays provide a practical and reliable solution by creating dedicated, low-profile storage space beneath the wheelchair frame. These trays are designed to support a wide range of critical equipment, including oxygen cylinders, suction machines, portable ventilators, battery packs, and other medical devices that may need to be used continuously. By keeping equipment securely positioned under the chassis, they help maintain a clean, organised seating environment without compromising comfort or mobility. Under-chassis trays are designed around real-world care requirements, supporting frequent transfers in and out of the wheelchair, carer-led adjustments, indoor and outdoor use, and transport in accessible vehicles. Their integrated design helps ensure equipment remains stable and accessible while supporting long-duration comfort and consistent seating performance. Specifically, under-chassis trays provide a secure sub-frame storage platform that helps keep weight low for improved wheelchair stability. They also protect equipment from accidental knocks and damage, free up rear and side space for carers and additional accessories, and support continuous use without interfering with postural setup or seating alignment. By combining safety, practicality, and accessibility, under-chassis equipment trays help make daily care more manageable for both users and carers while supporting complex mobility and medical requirements.

Chunc Limited|oxygen cylinder mounts.description: Oxygen Cylinder Mounts This oxygen cylinder mount has been carefully designed to provide a stable and secure method of holding oxygen cylinders during routine, day-to-day use. Built with durability and reliability in mind, the system reflects a strong focus on quality materials and sound engineering principles, giving clinicians and families confidence in its performance within a static care environment. The mount integrates seamlessly with the Chunc chair range, while its adaptable design means it may also be suitable for use with other wheelchair models. This flexibility allows it to meet a wide range of user needs without compromising on stability or ease of use. Its straightforward attachment and secure hold make it an essential accessory for individuals who require consistent access to oxygen therapy, supporting both independence and comfort. While the system has not been formally crash tested or validated for use in moving vehicles, its design ensures that, when properly installed, the cylinder remains well-supported during normal use. For situations involving transport, it is important that a separate, user-led risk assessment is carried out. Factors such as wheelchair configuration, vehicle type, and additional accessories can all influence safety, and appropriate precautions should always be taken to ensure the cylinder is correctly positioned and fully restrained. Overall, this mount offers a dependable, high-quality solution for safely carrying oxygen in everyday settings—supporting users, families, and clinicians with a practical and adaptable piece of equipment. For a full-time wheelchair user.

Chunc Limited|communication aid mounting.description: Communication Aid Mounting Brackets For communication aids to be truly effective, correct and consistent positioning is essential. Mounting the device to the wheelchair is therefore just as important as the technology itself, ensuring the user can access it reliably throughout the day. Chunc’s communication aid bracket provides a secure and stable mounting solution, keeping the device within the user’s optimal line of sight and reachable range at all times. This supports more immediate access to communication, reducing the need for caregiver assistance with setup or repositioning and enabling greater independence, faster interaction, and more natural conversation. The bracket assembly is height adjustable to accommodate individual postural requirements and user needs, supporting optimal positioning across a range of seating setups. Designed for versatility, it is compatible with a wide variety of communication aids and integrates seamlessly with Chunc wheelchair systems. This solution helps ensure that communication remains consistently accessible, supporting participation, expression, and engagement in daily life. Please note: This product includes the bracket assembly only. Communication devices are not included.

Chunc Limited|activity tray.description: Activity Tray An activity tray is more than a surface for tasks — it acts as a postural, functional, and assistive support system within a wheelchair seating setup. By providing a stable, accessible platform, it helps promote improved posture, upper limb control, and functional independence during a wide range of daily activities. The tray offers secure forearm and hand positioning, supporting comfort and stability for tasks such as eating, writing, using communication aids, and engaging in sensory or educational activities. This helps users maintain a more functional upper body position while carrying out everyday tasks. Designed with practicality in mind, the tray features a durable, easy-clean surface with raised edges to help prevent items from slipping or falling. It can be securely fitted to all Chunc wheelchairs and is designed for quick and easy removal, supporting safe and efficient transfers when required. The activity tray also helps create a structured, contained working area, allowing users to focus visually and physically on the activity in front of them. Essential items such as plates, books, or devices can be positioned within easy reach, supporting consistency and predictability in daily routines. By combining postural support with functional usability, the activity tray enhances independence, safety, and meaningful engagement in everyday activities.

Chunc Limited|recline kit (180°).description: Recline Kit (180°) This configuration provides the highest level of clinical flexibility, combining tilt-in-space with full recline to 180°, enabling transition from seated to a fully supine position. It supports full pressure redistribution and offers enhanced capability for managing complex needs, including high tone and spasticity. The ability to reposition fully within the chair can assist with hygiene care, unplanned events, and situations where reducing transfers is beneficial for both the user and carers. Tilt-in-space continues to provide effective pressure management and postural stability during seated phases, while full recline enables complete body repositioning when required. An important clinical consideration is that postural supports must be readjusted when moving into supine and again when returning to an upright position, as alignment changes significantly through these transitions. Tilt-in-space at 45° underpins postural stability and pressure management, with recline extending capability to full supine positioning—introducing additional clinical considerations that must be managed as part of a complete seating system. Selection of the appropriate configuration should always be guided by an Occupational Therapist or specialist seating assessment to ensure safe and effective clinical outcomes.

Chunc Limited|recline kit (160°).description: Recline Kit (160°) Combining pressure care through tilt-in-space with functional repositioning via recline, this configuration delivers a highly effective and stable seating solution. Recline 160 opens the back angle up to 160°, allowing the user to move into a semi-supine position while keeping all postural supports in place. The backrest moves backwards while the seat remains fixed, opening the hip angle and enabling the user to “lean back” without compromising their established positioning. This differs from tilt-in-space, where the entire seating system tilts as one unit, maintaining all body angles. When used together, tilt and recline provide complementary benefits—tilt supports pressure redistribution and minimises shear, while recline enables controlled changes in posture and hip angle. Reclining helps redistribute pressure away from the pelvis and sitting bones and can support users who experience fatigue in upright sitting. It allows the body to settle where independent postural control is limited, offering rest periods without the need for transfers. This can reduce physical demand on carers and improve tolerance for extended periods of use, including community participation. Tilt-in-space at 45° underpins postural stability and pressure management, with recline adding controlled hip angle adjustment—introducing additional clinical considerations such as shear, which must be managed as part of a complete seating system. Selection of the appropriate configuration should always be guided by an Occupational Therapist or specialist seating assessment to ensure safe and effective clinical outcomes.

Chunc Limited|elbow blockers.description: Elbow Blockers Chunc elbow blockers are designed to improve upper limb positioning, providing supportive guidance for the arms and elbows to enhance comfort, control, and overall sitting stability. Particularly beneficial for users with reduced muscle control, they help maintain consistent arm placement on the armrests, preventing the arms from slipping off the side or falling behind the seat. By supporting the upper limbs, elbow blockers contribute to improved overall postural alignment and can help reduce slumping during seated activities. This added stability supports a more balanced upper body position, which in turn can enhance functional comfort throughout the day. Elbow blockers also help reduce fatigue by minimising strain on the shoulder and upper back muscles during prolonged sitting. In addition, they help prevent accidental arm movement that could lead to discomfort or injury, particularly during wheelchair movement, transfers, or changes in position. This ensures the arms remain safely positioned and clearly supported at all times. Chunc elbow blockers are available in left and right-handed options, as well as small and large sizes, allowing for tailored positioning to suit individual user needs and seating configurations.

Chunc Limited|height adjustable arm supp.description: Height Adjustable Arm Support (Pair) Standard or Multiplane Adjustable arm supports provide consistent and reliable forearm support, helping clinicians fine-tune upper limb positioning to improve posture, stability, and comfort throughout the day. With flexible mounting and adjustable positioning, the system supports a wide range of clinical needs and functional goals. Both options help to: Promote midline orientation Reduce compensatory trunk movements Support a more stable and energy-efficient sitting posture Reduce load through the shoulders Improve overall trunk alignment Provide a stable base for functional activities Front or rear mounting options allow the setup to be tailored for both clinical positioning and practical considerations, including safe transfers in and out of the wheelchair. Option 1: Height Adjustable Arm Supports Height adjustable arm supports provide reliable forearm support for users who benefit from improved upper limb positioning but do not require additional containment. Adjustable height and flexible mounting allow precise alignment, helping maintain a supported and symmetrical sitting posture. This option is ideal for: Reduced trunk control Postural asymmetry Fatigue from unsupported arms Functional activity support Option 2: Multiplane Adjustable Arm Supports with Elbow Containment The multiplane adjustable arm supports with elbow containment provide a higher level of positioning and stability for users with limited or no voluntary arm control. Multi-axis adjustability — including height, angle, width, and mounting position — allows highly individualised setup. Integrated elbow containment offers gentle guidance to: Help prevent shoulder subluxation Reduce uncontrolled or involuntary arm movement Support consistent midline orientation Improve overall postural integrity Reduce asymmetrical loading This option is particularly beneficial where muscle tone fluctuates, arm control is limited, or unsupported movement impacts posture or safe
features: Support a more stable and energy-efficient sitting posture

Chunc Limited|toe straps.description: Toe Straps Featuring a convenient hook-and-loop fastening system, these straps allow for quick, adjustable, and hassle-free application and removal, ensuring a secure yet comfortable fit. Made from durable nylon fabric, they provide long-lasting performance while maintaining user comfort throughout the day. When selecting the appropriate straps, it’s important to choose a length that allows for easy adjustment, accommodating different footwear styles and ensuring a proper fit at all times. Sold in pairs: 58cm strap length

Chunc Limited|ankle huggers.description: Ankle Huggers Chunc Ankle Huggers are anatomically contoured to surround the ankle, providing lateral stability while evenly distributing pressure for improved comfort and skin protection. Ankle huggers aid foot positioning and act as an alternative to foot straps. Stabilising the foot and ankle helps improve balance and supports better posture when sitting or moving. Their dynamic, flexible design offers a more comfortable and effective alternative to traditional rigid foot straps. Sold in pairs.

Chunc Limited|shoulder harnessing.description: Shoulder Harnessing Chest harnesses are designed to provide additional upper body positioning within a wheelchair seating system. Used as a secondary postural support, they help improve trunk and upper thoracic alignment by offering gentle anterior and posterior stability. This makes them particularly beneficial when pelvic positioning and lateral supports alone are not enough to maintain functional sitting posture. Harnessing should always complement, not replace, a well-configured seating setup. Accurate measurement and correct fitting are essential to achieve effective support, even pressure distribution, and long-term comfort. When properly positioned, the harness should sit securely across the chest without shifting during use, supporting stability while allowing functional movement. A range of harness styles is available to suit different clinical needs. Cross-shoulder harnesses are typically used for higher levels of postural instability, asymmetry, or reduced trunk control. They help promote midline thoracic alignment and reduce asymmetrical collapse, making them suitable for users with significant instability, complex tone patterns, or poor head and trunk dissociation. Narrow front-pull harnesses are suited to users requiring lighter support. These designs offer greater upper limb freedom while helping to resist forward flexion. They are often appropriate for mild to moderate instability or when reminder-style support is sufficient to maintain positioning. Regular review is recommended to ensure the harness continues to provide effective support as needs change. Monitoring fit and positioning helps maintain comfort, minimise the risk of pressure, and ensure the user receives appropriate postural support within their overall seating system.

Chunc Limited|lap belt.description: Lap Belt Designed to help maintain a stable and safe pelvic position in a seated posture. Secured across the pelvis (hips), anchoring chair user into the seat. It is positioned across the bony pelvis and adjusted to provide secure but non-restrictive support. A 2-point system is typically used as the baseline option. Preventing forward sliding in the seat, maintaining general pelvic stability. Supports a neutral seated posture in users with: Good or moderate trunk control Predictable sitting balance Low to moderate postural asymmetry A 4-point system provides additional directional control of the pelvis, using two anterior and two posterior/anchoring points. Best for complex or unstable sitting postures: Actively controls pelvic alignment in multiple planes Help correct or manage asymmetry Reduces pelvic rotation and uneven loading If you would like support identifying the most appropriate option for an individual, or need help reviewing an existing seating setup, please get in touch.
features: Actively controls pelvic alignment in multiple planes
Reduces pelvic rotation and uneven loading

Chunc Limited|footplates.description: Footplates Chunc footplates provide essential lower limb support, creating a stable base that helps promote balanced weight distribution and improved seated posture. Without appropriate foot support, a greater proportion of body weight is transferred to the thighs and ischial tuberosities, increasing the risk of discomfort and pressure-related concerns. Properly adjusted footplates help redistribute load more evenly, reducing pressure on the buttocks and rear thighs during prolonged sitting. In addition to pressure management, footplates play an important role in overall postural stability. By maintaining consistent foot positioning, they help support correct pelvic alignment, which forms the foundation for trunk stability and spinal positioning. This can reduce the likelihood of slouching, forward sliding, and asymmetrical sitting. Footplates also improve safety by preventing the feet from dragging, striking objects, or becoming caught in wheelchair components such as caster wheels. This helps support safer mobility both indoors and outdoors. For optimal positioning, footplates should typically be adjusted to achieve approximately 90° at the hips, knees, and ankles, supporting a neutral and balanced seated posture. Swing-away or elevating options can improve access for transfers, allowing the user to position closer to beds, chairs, or toilets while supporting safer transitions. Chunc footplates are available in a range of configurations, including fixed full-width platforms for consistent support, and independent (split) footplates for users requiring individual leg positioning and adjustability.

Chunc Limited|calf pads.description: Calf Pads Chunc calf pads are designed to enhance lower limb stability, comfort, and safety for wheelchair users. They help maintain correct leg positioning during movement and seating adjustments, including when the seat is tilted or the leg rests are elevated. By supporting the calves, they reduce strain on heel straps and help promote more even pressure distribution across the lower limbs. In addition to improving comfort, calf pads play an important safety role by helping to prevent the feet from slipping off the footrests or becoming caught in wheelchair components. This reduces the risk of injury and supports more secure, confident positioning throughout the day. Calf pads provide both postural support and safety benefits, contributing to improved overall seating stability. For best results, they should be used alongside other foot positioning accessories such as heel loops and footplate padding to ensure balanced support and optimal pressure management.

Chunc Limited|seat cushions.description: Seat Cushions The range at a glance: Standard shaped – everyday comfort and protection without correction Contour – guided positioning with improved stability Ischial – focused protection of key pressure points with pelvic stability Enhanced contour – advanced postural support for more complex needs From comfort and protection without correction through to guided positioning with improved stability, and focused protection of key pressure points with pelvic support. Simply use the selector tool to find the most appropriate level of support. An assessment is recommended where there are concerns around prolonged sitting, reduced mobility, or changing postural needs. Preventing pressure ulcers is a key benefit, particularly for people with spinal cord injury, stroke, or reduced sensation. Improving posture and body alignment, appropriate seating can help address issues such as pelvic obliquity, forward sliding, and postural asymmetry, supporting a more balanced sitting position. Enhancing comfort and tolerance of sitting allows longer, more comfortable periods of use, helping support participation in daily activities and reducing the risk of secondary complications associated with poor sitting posture or prolonged pressure.

Chunc Limited|pommel.description: Pommel The Chunc pommel is a clinical positioning aid. Its purpose is to improve lower-limb alignment, enhance postural stability, and support safe, comfortable seated function. It is particularly beneficial for individuals who require assistance maintaining leg alignment and preventing unwanted forward or lateral movement while seated. Positioned between the legs, the pommel helps guide and stabilise the user’s posture, supporting a more secure and functional seating position. This can improve overall comfort, reduce the risk of sliding, and enhance stability during everyday activities. The pommel is available in both fixed and adjustable options, allowing clinicians and caregivers to select the most appropriate setup for each user’s needs. Its padded design ensures comfort during prolonged use, while its durable construction supports consistent performance in daily environments. Designed for seamless compatibility with the Chunc wheelchair range, the pommel integrates easily into existing seating systems, providing a practical and effective solution for improved positioning and support.

Chunc Limited|supportive back cushion.description: Supportive Back Cushion The custom contoured wheelchair back supports provide enhanced postural control straight away. Its shape is designed to closely match the user’s body rather than relying on flat or generic surfaces. This can reduce fatigue, improve sitting tolerance, and enhance functional performance such as head control and upper limb freedom. A key strength of the design is the structured back pan, which provides a stable foundation for further postural refinement. This allows lateral supports to be added with a high degree of flexibility in type, size, depth, and positioning, enabling precise adjustment to suit individual clinical presentations. This modular approach means the system can be progressively configured—from mild support through to complex, multi-point control—helping build a scalable product range that can meet a wide spectrum of client needs. For More Complex Postural Needs For users requiring advanced, multi-point trunk support, the Octoback system offers a fully modular backrest solution with independently adjustable segments to support the pelvis, lumbar, and thoracic regions.

Chunc Limited|standard back support.description: Standard Back Support Chunc’s Standard Back Support Cushion is designed for use with our wheelchair range. Offering reliable postural support for children and adults with varying trunk control needs, this straightforward yet effective cushion helps maintain upright posture, providing stability and comfort throughout daily use. The padded design gently supports the back while distributing pressure evenly to help reduce fatigue and discomfort. Its simple, durable construction makes it easy to position and adjust, supporting consistent setup across different environments. Clinicians and caregivers can select from a range of cushion sizes to achieve the most appropriate fit for each user. By combining comfort and stability, this back support cushion offers a practical and clinically informed solution for everyday postural support. Designed for wheelchair users with more complex postural requirements, this back support also contributes to improved trunk control and alignment. By supporting a neutral pelvic base and encouraging optimal spinal positioning, it can help manage asymmetries such as scoliosis while promoting overall stability. Carefully contoured surfaces and pressure-distributing materials work together to reduce the risk of pressure-related discomfort during prolonged use. Integrated seamlessly with the wider seating setup, the cushion supports functional movement, breathing, and upper body use, contributing to safer and more effective daily positioning.

Chunc Limited|lateral trunk support.description: Lateral Trunk Support Lateral supports provide essential trunk positioning for wheelchair users requiring additional stability and alignment. With adjustments in width, depth, height, and angle, they enable precise set-up to optimise posture, balance, and functional comfort. Multi-angular positioning allows the supports to accommodate complex body shapes and postures, maintaining consistent trunk contact where needed. This makes them suitable for users with asymmetry or evolving postural requirements. The hardware is lightweight yet durable, featuring reversible brackets with dual length options and slotted adjustment points for straightforward installation and fine-tuning. Quick-release and swing-away options allow the supports to be moved or removed easily, supporting safe transfers and flexibility in use. A wide choice of pad shapes, sizes, and cover materials ensures an appropriate fit for each individual. Selecting the correct pad contour and pressure-relieving properties is important to help reduce the risk of skin breakdown, particularly around bony prominences. Available back-mounted (seating shell) or cane-mounted (wheelchair uprights) configurations. The back assembly is engineered for compatibility with a wide range of third-party accessories, facilitating continuity of care. By combining targeted adjustability with supportive stability, lateral trunk supports enhance posture and enable greater comfort and participation in daily activities.

Chunc Limited|winged contour head suppor.description: Winged Contour Head Support The Chunc Winged Contour Headrest is specifically designed for seamless integration with our wheelchair range. Offering reliable and comfortable head support for both paediatric and adult users with complex postural needs, its unique winged design gently cradles the head, providing lateral support that helps maintain midline alignment without restricting natural movement. Fully adjustable, this headrest allows clinicians and caregivers to position it precisely to each user’s individual requirements, supporting optimal postural alignment and functional positioning. The padded surface ensures comfort and effective pressure distribution, making it suitable for prolonged use throughout daily activities. By promoting stability, comfort, and improved head positioning, the winged contour headrest enhances overall seating tolerance and supports better postural outcomes. It offers a versatile solution for therapists, caregivers, and prescribers seeking a clinically effective head support system.

Chunc Limited|contoured adjustable head.description: Contoured Adjustable Head Support Designed by Chunc specifically for seamless compatibility with our wheelchair range. This contoured headrest delivers effective head and neck support for users with complex postural needs. It is ideal for both paediatric and adult users who require improved head positioning, stability, and comfort in their seating system. The contoured shape gently cradles the head, helping to promote midline alignment while reducing the risk of fatigue, asymmetry, and poor head control. This makes it particularly beneficial for users who need consistent, supportive positioning throughout the day. The adjustability of the headrest allows clinicians and prescribers to achieve precise positioning tailored to each individual. This flexibility supports optimal clinical outcomes while ensuring the user remains comfortable and well supported during everyday activities. A cushioned surface provides effective pressure distribution, enhancing comfort during extended use, while the supportive structure contributes to improved postural stability. As part of the Chunc wheelchair accessory range, this headrest integrates easily with our seating systems, offering a reliable solution for therapists, caregivers, and users alike.

Elekta|the 2023 aamd plan study a questi.product: The 2023 Aamd Plan Study A Question Of Time
Elekta|the 2023 aamd plan study a questi.description: The 2023 AAMD Plan Study - A Question of Time May 3, 2023 5 minute read Hi there, everyone! This short message is to announce the 2023 AAMD ProKnow Plan Study , which is, as always, open to anybody and everybody in the international radiation therapy community. The more people who participate, the more we all learn and move forward, so we hope that hundreds of you can carve out a little time in your schedule in the month of May to take part. We are trying a unique strategy for this study — a strategy that introduces some different, but timely, learning objectives that have immediate relevance to our day-to-day craft. Here, we will summarize these objectives and tell you the “next steps” for getting started. A “Timely” Question In conventional plan studies, you are provided a dataset with images and predefined anatomy, then given a challenging plan quality scorecard to use to create and assess your treatment plan. By looking at the population, and in particular, high-performing plans, we can learn which techniques, technologies, and human tacticians can score the highest. Then, we gather those methods and try to share them with you all, along with giving the interactive (and anonymi
features: Phase 1 will look like a conventional, scored plan study. However, there is NO need to spend inordinate time trying to optimize your score here. Rather, just create a practical, high-quality plan that you are happy with, following the basic instructions. The scores of the initial plans will be studied only in terms of their relationship to the ultimate efficiency metric of the adaptive plan and not as a primary focus.
Do this phase of the study whenever it’s convenient for you. You do not need to time yourself or reserve chunks of time in your schedule for this phase!
Start your timer as soon as you import the new images and structures into your planning system.

The scorecard for Phase 2 will have the same metrics as the initial plan (with perhaps a twist or two, emulating an ambitious radiation oncologist), but the objectives will be binary (either “goal met” or “goal not met”).
Your job is this: Using your initial plan as a starting point, you will design plan(s) for the new anatomy until you meet all the binary goals.
Once you have a plan that meets all the goals, stop your timer , then calculate your planning time (in units of hours, e.g., 1.25 hours).
Submit your adaptive plan to ProKnow and answer the survey questions , the most critical one of which is how long it took to create the adaptive plan that met all goals.
What is the variation in planning time it takes to achieve all goals for all metrics for an adaptive plan?
What is the variation in adaptive planning time across different TPS models?
Is there any correlation in adaptive planning time vs. original plan score (i.e., does a higher quality initial plan makes adaptive planning faster)?
Is there a correlation in adaptive planning time vs. user-specified software or hardware “grade?”
Does adaptive planning speed vary with years of treatment planning experience?
For any given TPS, what tips and techniques can speed up the process of designing an adaptive plan?

Love Medical|minipulse mp1.description: The MiniPulse range is the preferred choice for clinicians requiring a versatile, high-performance solution for oxygen saturation and heart rate monitoring. Designed for both rapid spot-checking and continuous short-term monitoring, these handheld devices are suitable for a full range of patient demographics, from neonates and infants to paediatric and adult patients. Clinically Validated Precision in a Portable Format Available in two lightweight models, the MiniPulse series is engineered to deliver fast, reliable measurements in almost any clinical setting. At the core of each device is clinically validated technology that ensures consistent and accurate results, providing clinicians with the confidence needed for critical diagnostic decisions. Its rugged yet ergonomic construction makes it ideal for the demanding environments of hospital wards, emergency services, and outpatient clinics.

Love Medical|amedtec holter system ecg p.description: The AMEDTEC Holter System ECGpro® 12 is the premier choice for clinicians requiring high-speed, high-fidelity long-term ECG analysis. By combining sophisticated detection algorithms with a highly intuitive user interface, the system transforms vast amounts of data into actionable diagnostic insights, ensuring that even multi-day recordings are processed with unparalleled speed and accuracy. Full-Disclosure Monitoring without Compromise The ECGpro® 12 allows for continuous, multi-day recordings of up to 7 days without the need for data reduction or lossy compression. This “full-disclosure” approach ensures that every heartbeat is captured and available for clinical review. The transition from recorder to report is seamless: the system features simplified device preparation and automatic patient assignment upon data import, significantly reducing the administrative burden on clinical staff. Efficiency at a Glance Analysis Speed: < 60 seconds for visual control. Reporting Speed: < 5 minutes for final diagnosis and findings. Recording Duration: Up to 7 days of raw, uncompressed data. Workflow: Automated data import and patient matching.

Love Medical|tango m2 non invasive bp.description: The Tango M2 Stress Test Monitor provides clinicians with the ultimate confidence that patient movement, mechanical vibration, and observer variability will not compromise diagnostic accuracy. Engineered specifically for the high-intensity environment of the stress lab, the Tango M2 automates blood pressure acquisition, allowing your team to maintain their primary focus where it matters most: on the patient. Engineered for Motion and High-Noise Environments Recording reliable blood pressure intervals during exercise is traditionally one of the most difficult tasks in cardiac diagnostics. The Tango M2 overcomes these challenges using our proprietary DKA algorithm, which filters out the noise and motion interference associated with treadmill and ergometer testing. When paired with the specialised Orbit-K™ Cuff, the system delivers exceptional performance, ensuring that precise readings are initiated at the exact moment required for each stage of your stress protocol. Technical Specifications Display: 7-inch High-Resolution Colour LCD. Interface: Automated RS-232 or USB communication with Stress ECG systems. Memory: Internal storage for up to 300 readings. Validation: Specifically optimised for Treadmill, Ergometer, and Pharmacological Stress testing.

Love Medical|ergoline ergoscan ambulator.description: The ergoscan system represents a sophisticated approach to ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, combining advanced oscillometric technology with durable, clinician-focused design. Engineered for high-traffic medical environments, the ergoscan ensures the acquisition of clean, reliable data while prioritising ease of use for both the patient and the healthcare provider. Precision Technology and Artefact Suppression At the core of the ergoscan is a specialised oscillometric measuring logic that eliminates the need for cumbersome microphones or electrodes. This technology is specifically designed to suppress motion artefacts, ensuring that readings remain accurate even during the patient’s daily activities. The result is a more comfortable patient experience and a significantly more reliable diagnostic dataset for the clinician. Intelligent Workflow and Data Integrity The ergoscan is built for the rigours of daily clinical practice. It features a robust, snap-on metal cuff connector that ensures a secure, leak-proof attachment between the cuff and the recorder. To further enhance data accuracy, the device includes a dedicated day/night button. This allows the patient to manually signal their actual sleep transitions, enabling the software to precisely evaluate diurnally important differences without the need for manual, time-consuming corrections after the test.

Love Medical|amedtec ambulatory bp.description: The AMEDTEC Holter-RR is a premier solution for 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM), designed to deliver highly accurate, meaningful data in a patient-friendly format. Validated to the most stringent international standards, this system provides clinicians with a reliable foundation for the diagnosis and management of hypertension and related cardiovascular conditions. Intelligent Comfort and Clinical Versatility Patient compliance is critical to successful ambulatory monitoring. The Holter-RR utilises Auto Feedback Logic (AFL), an advanced inflation algorithm that ensures quiet, rapid measurements with significantly lower cuff pressure. Snoring is most likely to happen while sleeping on your back, as the muscles in the throat relax and drop, causing snoring sounds and airway obstructions. The device produces small vibrations to stop you from sleeping on your back, preventing obstructions. The belt is adjustable to fit most and is made with a gentle, lightweight, breathable fabric preventing perspiration and is designed to be worn across the waist or chest. The device has two clips that allow it to be worn without a belt, directly on an undergarment. Using the belt When the device detects you are sleeping on your back, it produces small vibrations with brief intervals until you return to sleeping on your side. The small electronic device is attached to a comfortable, adjustable belt which can be worn on the waist or chest while sleeping. With 7 settings, the vibration level can be easily adjusted for your comfort. Benefits of the PosiForm Anti Snore Belt Trains patients to sleep in healthy positions comfortably Effective snoring and POSA treatment Comfortable, customisable and easy to wear Adjustable and adaptable The simple to use belt can be easily adjusted to your preferred vibration intensity. Simply press the middle button and adjust to your required intensity. The adaptable device can be set to a higher level for those who sleep very deeply or those with a higher BMI. The PosiForm anti snoring belt is available in a universal size, with an elasticated adjustable strap to fit to your shape: The fabric belt size is recommended for waist circumferences of 70-125 centimetres. Coolmed|cmrtsg400 glass door rts cabinet.description: This medium-sized glass door refrigerator has a net capacity of 400l and provides plenty of storage space in a compact cabinet. It defrosts automatically and is fitted with a 2m plug for ease of installation. The temperature range is from 15-25°C and is stabilised by our high quality temperature sensor, which keeps the internal temperature even and stable. The fridge records minimum and maximum temperatures when plugged into the power source, but will continue to operate if this fails by running on the batteries installed in the panel on the side of the cabinet. The interior of the cabinet is painted aluminium and there are plastic-coated wire shelves for ease of cleaning. The LED display controller can be easily set to your required temperature. A bright LED strip lamp gives clear illumination to the interior. If the temperature drops below or raises above the set level, an audible alarm will sound. Similarly, the alarm will sound if the door is accidentally left open or not shut properly. The refrigerator has adjustable feet to ensure stability and the door is lockable, with 2 keys provided. 2 year warranty.

Hospital Direct|bariatric patient bundle.description: Our specially curated Batriatric Patient Bundle is perfect for bariatric patients. The SIBA® 120cm x 200cm fitted base sheet has been designed to fit a standard 120cm wide bariatric bed. The panel is “2-way slide” and uses our exclusive & pressure tested satin fabric for comfort, and to ease re-positioning. The SIBA® 225cm x 200cm 4-way draw sheet can hold most patients up to 400kg / 62.98st. This Draw Sheet has built-in and concealed handles for use with a hoist. It also comes fitted with our Locking Loops – which allow the sheet to be attached to a top structural (but moving), part of the bed. Ensuring it doesn’t slip down when the bed is profiled. I have also included a large HD Deluxe™ Body Positioning Wedge in this bundle. We have carefully designed these to bring you what we feel is the most flexible wedge solution available. Combining maximum support with a clever anti-slip, non-permeable cover, many find it invaluable with re-positioning, or holding a position. All of these items are available individually on the website, but we have made it easier for you – you can order them all together here!

Hospital Direct|transatlantic mini non-f.description: The Mini Rollboard is our shortest rollboard. It was originally designed for urology/gynaecology and emergency/recovery departments. But its versatility means their popularity goes way beyond that now. Because they only support the upper body during lateral transfers, stopping just below the coccyx, they are perfect for operations involving the Trendelenburg position. But just as helpful, (and far more simply), they are also great if it is just storage that is your issue. Providing your patient’s legs can be supported by other means, the Mini’s flexibility is hard to beat. As a result carers, or departments such as day surgery, radiology, and imaging, are using them daily. Technical The nylon cloth on the Mini Rollboard moves freely around the board like a tank track. This means users can smoothly slide their patients from one lateral surface to another in a perfectly controlled manor. The cloth is robust, tear-resistant, anti-bacterial, anti-fungal and flame-retardant. So be reassured that with three year warranty (including excessive use) purchasing the mini board is a safe investment. And please don’t be misled by the Mini Rollboard’s small 0.89kg stature. Its 50cm girth and 350kg safe working load make it ample for most adults – and capable of bridging a gap of up to 20cm. So ideal for bed to table/trolley transfers. We recommend pairing your Mini board with the Transatlantic disposable covers and particularly useful Transatlantic organiser . If you need more advice on the Transatlantic mini non-folding rollboard, please get in touch with our Technical Team. We will be delighted to help. Hospital Direct|auto cushion – car seat.product: Auto Cushion – Car Seat Mobility Cushion
Hospital Direct|auto cushion – car seat.description: For those with mobility issues getting in and out of a car is often a significant problem which this product solves. Many consider the freedom hitting the road brings to them is key to their independence but sadly many are held back from this freedom simply because transferring into, or out of, their car is too hard. Often, the hardest part is the rotating motion required to turn into the vehicle and vice versa. Moving back into the seat is also a common struggle for people who struggle with mobility. Our Auto Cushion is a revolutionary concept in car seat mobility aids so you can now be supported when turning onto your car seat, or re-positioning yourself comfortably, and also back out of the car again. It is an aid for all areas where entering or existing a car is vitally important, without compromising your safety. Download Instruction Leaflet
